Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Our volunteer student canvassers have been through the wringer these past couple of months.

Doors get slammed in their faces. They get shouted off stoops. And sometimes, even worse things happen.

So, I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two weeks.

Pro-Life Friend, our student canvassers know what’s on the line.

They know if abortion-loving leftists seize power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies.

And they know the job's not done yet.

But right now, they could use a little moral boost heading into the final weeks before Election Day on Tuesday, November 3rd.

[That’s why I’m hoping you’ll prayerfully consider sending a Care Package to one of our door-to-door canvassers](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=decb731ecbd74412be5453a2567b5ca1&_e=HMEmGS6BJx7k2P0FFVJZ2XfiLwL8taVB5A75AHcoZ81BymLSj73ZjOHi21UPl-zAT-eQn14LrbCfpo4cC2YAmOSPGVMFbiJyMgP_Pmnppy05XtBn3_5tDIpl5DnG7Bdl5-1Gzuq4hzZ2LFlicdSKfNS9mBlb7lxjMXwkdDRU8cmhBW4fWCq5AB7nYElNjkH7BwDSAJuAX4p4lLSb_E-6DVsMZAU62U21iZit05O4LeGfvpzIdl2XxOdw3104FEh7cK4_ID-QkIYg9X67E_G3xYCEuohAM7CYorikCMGThkyjoohS81SlDXaT9bLR95BCsLvntWubcs_cj7mB7PWBCC0DgdhFKikNVVFsu05C_lpFcWDeuYMt9RAHG8BiNw4NnSXtNoFMdoxsaONph-GdUUk-7OQpRpMKUTRgPNqKRKBFU8mUDPd8LxO_UyjXMdcYdvar6MKBW1nRLF0yuYn3UiU97OTi4NVWxJYw7-wvLiL9xbECOpdkvOs2OSKNOPdwEaur5yAfHf0qneqU20bbubSXRlNRoYrbV2vkwC3RB6o5J6vKwEEPsOEWMtTNZxbq1YEZUSJp5ANLnqj6H6bqHmgz6smszJXMLRRM86LXeykf6vm3QJrZq8myrtY_DToTPLZ96CH_eXjA6C7wAMM6eHc5PzfcgoalJId6C__ODT0%3D)**.**

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

These young women and men will be on their feet for hours, walking door to door. And knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going.

Of course, I could tell our door knockers to go home.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad ever could. And the effect doesn't disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote again in the next election, too.**

And, it costs us less than $3 for every door we knock.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.

**> >> In Oklahoma,** our canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion state senators who killed our legislation to stop chemical abortion pill trafficking. Voters threw them out.

**> >> In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who killed our "Life at Conception Act." They lost too.

**> >> In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries.

The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to give up and go home during this final stretch.

It's true they have the money, the media, and the institutions.

But what they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words, and still go knock on the next door.

That grit and determination is what wins elections.

[So, will you please make your most generous contribution today to keep our canvassers in the field through the two most important weeks of this election season](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=decb731ecbd74412be5453a2567b5ca1&_e=HMEmGS6BJx7k2P0FFVJZ2XfiLwL8taVB5A75AHcoZ81BymLSj73ZjOHi21UPl-zAT-eQn14LrbCfpo4cC2YAmOSPGVMFbiJyMgP_Pmnppy05XtBn3_5tDIpl5DnG7Bdl5-1Gzuq4hzZ2LFlicdSKfNS9mBlb7lxjMXwkdDRU8clY9OV69WWPhVfxFj0j4cOdPzzEjUyzFwF4KysjJxcSEzrHxGO1J5v4rvhYesF9RDjeeXl5vdf-oQJzBPl2MwbCy1Hrd_-eKA9dmGhiA2tJ43T1lKXKyuhoYpy250eKVzFh6cHaewqnNJPAyHvEfQlHiIkU3NryFhhHxUJFcysP0D2JzpKAWXQml77Y6NJuVReO6ugzm7UwDWVwY8S6gf4JWPRNt5r5sp1doAQo5Ff-aDgBUiGA71jJp4hysXmKr5IvfAWIBLqQX73nPQZUlwPY4i62En1SDSJc_9ojOvFDgJzBEpX8ONJYHn6-1p7PcCrgaAHA8jVzmB_De1wwn-9lxXWXQ4-PkbBtU-a9RAhndMoNPVJTEqL2kiwVrQmK_b-vP0Uoe78l_yy-pBNMYpFAWn8yn0f2-8FhMGMmk-8Fs2WmImzFmnSBC1Up7KxylUFxm9IXSbOOF9DfAwMScyM74uuw3ZpUlqVi4ro7J6ZzDkMaJkNLGav5mq2HHQ-ddzs%3D)**?**

**> >> $250** fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field: more than 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $100** puts a canvasser on more than 30 doors in a key race.

**> >> $50** covers a tank of gas for a canvasser's day of driving to and from strategic locations.

**> >> $25** pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field.

**> >> $10** puts our pro-life message on more than three doors.

Pro-Life Friend, door knocking has been our key to beating both the Abortion Lobby and the D.C. consultant class for years.

You see, they like wasting their donors' money on flashy, expensive cable TV ads because it lines their pockets.

Meanwhile, real people having real conversations are what actually move voters in November. That's how we helped 119 pro-life legislators WIN in 2024!

So, please let our dedicated student activists know you care about them and appreciate the hard work they're doing for the entire pro-life movement.

[Will you please send a Care Package to one of our canvassers right now](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=decb731ecbd74412be5453a2567b5ca1&_e=HMEmGS6BJx7k2P0FFVJZ2XfiLwL8taVB5A75AHcoZ81BymLSj73ZjOHi21UPl-zAT-eQn14LrbCfpo4cC2YAmOSPGVMFbiJyMgP_Pmnppy05XtBn3_5tDIpl5DnG7Bdl5-1Gzuq4hzZ2LFlicdSKfNS9mBlb7lxjMXwkdDRU8clWHLhfzBdl53aEks34v5AJhWNR4p8BFo14BC_KlHd_5CcTN8TE6XU14A0V2kFG-ZiMZpx5IbJORev63q94Zo0hG4jlisfYLBjkwKTfGrlTYZjeYaTx1r0-09Gc9EZzdxMlEEwlTbhU9zW7qenNMmySekfV-LN7Tti54uhmNeJFIkAZ_2m6ko5RGo8l7R3IpACyqOKBmNKny-P7LkBCZEtdOVCIneIGUHX04r0CVNk8_B52H1P0tD2aVM7VMwjvxQs3K39Ka4kQaZBdLdYn4MEylOUJDvEfZogRLkKtUzXRecDQ2nlmD4I9HYC_YdxUkmhLYSnXwfz7s8w4wMwf-B6P2NpwAmCUliA5UJRKPoguCMXIvu5u9EsZ-oRvb1sk1KgY_p7EUCZaR59rW7l5jDtSaUonxqguIkDuIGdXKJjO11QJb55fuwDSFRMdqntSVmb4IChwuVucLGL5jAkgPeJJdtg_V1rxQkxo-Zhtpfu0UywKkicUjxPLvvrOTv7CKws%3D)**?**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

clean_body: Dear Pro-Life Friend, Our volunteer student canvassers have been through the wringer these past couple of months. Doors get slammed in their faces. They get shouted off stoops. And sometimes, even worse things happen. So, I've told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two weeks. Pro-Life Friend, our student canvassers know what’s on the line. They know if abortion-loving leftists seize power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies. And they know the job's not done yet. But right now, they could use a little moral boost heading into the final weeks before Election Day on Tuesday, November 3rd. . My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement. These young women and men will be on their feet for hours, walking door to door. And knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going. Of course, I could tell our door knockers to go home. I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead. But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad ever could. And the effect doesn't disappear after one election. Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote again in the next election, too. And, it costs us less than $3 for every door we knock. This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that's needed to turn out every pro-life voter. Last cycle, this approach worked. >> In Oklahoma, our canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion state senators who killed our legislation to stop chemical abortion pill trafficking. Voters threw them out. >> In South Carolina, we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who killed our "Life at Conception Act." They lost too. >> In North Carolina, 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries. The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to give up and go home during this final stretch. It's true they have the money, the media, and the institutions. But what they don't have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger's door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words, and still go knock on the next door. That grit and determination is what wins elections. ? >> $250 fully funds a canvasser's entire day in the field: more than 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time. >> $100 puts a canvasser on more than 30 doors in a key race. >> $50 covers a tank of gas for a canvasser's day of driving to and from strategic locations. >> $25 pays for a canvasser's meals for a day in the field. >> $10 puts our pro-life message on more than three doors. Pro-Life Friend, door knocking has been our key to beating both the Abortion Lobby and the D.C. consultant class for years. You see, they like wasting their donors' money on flashy, expensive cable TV ads because it lines their pockets. Meanwhile, real people having real conversations are what actually move voters in November. That's how we helped 119 pro-life legislators WIN in 2024! So, please let our dedicated student activists know you care about them and appreciate the hard work they're doing for the entire pro-life movement. ? For Life, Kristan Hawkins President, Students for Life Action P.S. - Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd, and our canvassers will be knocking on doors right up to the finish line. . Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. body:
I don't usually do this

| Peter,**
**I don't usually do this, but I want to show you something personal today.
I dug up a few old photos – one with my siblings and my single mother, one from my time serving in Afghanistan, and one with my family, long before I set foot in politics.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
You see, people in Washington think they know my story because they've seen a 30-second ad or interview.
They don't, Peter.
They don't know what it felt like to leave a stable career behind after 9/11, or what it's like to sit in a helicopter over hostile territory, hoping you make it back with the soldier you came for.
I'm sharing these photos because I think you deserve to actually know who’s reaching out with these emails – not just a name on a donation page.
And with the threat of losing our House Majority looming over our heads, I’m counting on every Patriot’s support before November.
[If this story means something to you, I'd be grateful if you could chip in $5, $10, or $15 towards my campaign today.](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2521%2E135344%2Eov78_f)

LUR.
What is that?
It stands for "lowest unit rate." And what it means in the context of political campaigns is that when a candidate spends their campaign dollars on television ads, they get to pay the lowest cost possible to run that spot.
Super PACs -- the ones flooding the airwaves in key races across the country -- don't get that rate. And what that means is there are some states where super PACs are paying almost ten-times as much for an advertisement as the candidates themselves are paying.
Practically, that means when you see Elon Musk or some other Republican super PAC spending crazy sums of money in places like Iowa or Texas, that money doesn't go nearly as far as contributions made directly to the Democratic candidates.
That makes donations made in response to emails like this one extra important. Up to ten-times as important.
Yes, I said in response to emails like this one.
Because Josh Turek, our candidate for Senate in Iowa, can use our help in these final days. He is one of those candidates getting clobbered with ads by outside spending groups.
But even a small donation to his campaign goes a lot further than the same amount of money spent by a super PAC. Which is why I am asking:**
[**Can you please split a contribution to Josh Turek's campaign for United States Senate in Iowa and my work electing Democrats across the country in these final weeks?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-turek.N6xupi&refcode=em261015&t=2&akid=2521%2E135344%2Eov78_f)**

clean_body: LUR. What is that? It stands for "lowest unit rate." And what it means in the context of political campaigns is that when a candidate spends their campaign dollars on television ads, they get to pay the lowest cost possible to run that spot. Super PACs -- the ones flooding the airwaves in key races across the country -- don't get that rate. And what that means is there are some states where super PACs are paying almost ten-times as much for an advertisement as the candidates themselves are paying. Practically, that means when you see Elon Musk or some other Republican super PAC spending crazy sums of money in places like Iowa or Texas, that money doesn't go nearly as far as contributions made directly to the Democratic candidates. That makes donations made in response to emails like this one extra important. Up to ten-times as important. Yes, I said in response to emails like this one. | | Dear Fellow American, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. **Now he's fighting for his own freedom** – [**and he needs your help.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx.
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ **Support Sgt. Duran** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. [**Will you help Sgt. Duran fight for his freedom?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. **They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.** **Their own lives have been threatened because of this case.** That's why I’m asking for your help today. **[Please make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more to help fund Sgt. Duran's appeal and give him the resources he needs to fight for his freedom.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** **_Erik spent 15 years protecting others._** **_Now he needs people like you standing behind him.[Every donation makes a difference.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)_** **_Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran._** Sincerely,
---

Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**_

Facing the reality of his defeat in 2020, Donald Trump made the now-infamous call to Georgia SOS Brad Raffensperger in which he asked fellow Republicans to "find" him 11,780 votes to flip GA's election results.
While that effort ultimately failed, if Georgia officials had been willing to play ball and fabricated the votes to hand the election to Trump, they would have needed a state supreme court in their pockets to pull it off.
Enter the 2026 North Carolina State Supreme Court race: Democrat incumbent Justice Anita Earls is up against a sleepy, MAGA zombie candidate who is barely campaigning and hardly raises money for her own campaign--and polls show a tossup race. Why?
Because MAGA is propping up their nominee like Weekend at Bernie's, breathing life into a contest that will prove instrumental for control of the high court of a competitive swing state right in time for the 2028 presidential election.
In 2024 the Republican candidate for NC Supreme Court tried--and failed--to have 60,000 valid votes tossed out after the final vote count showed him losing by 750 votes. If we lose this race on Nov 3, the next attempt might finally succeed.

clean_body: | = Hi Peter, I'm Michelle White, executive director of EMILYs List. My job is to lead the staff of this organization and make sure we have the budget, resources, and strategy we need to elect Democratic pro-choice women at every level of government. I want to be very direct about why that matters. EMILYs List was founded because women candidates were not getting the early support they needed to run credible, competitive campaigns. Ellen Malcolm and a group of groundbreaking women knew that if women were going to win elections, they needed early money, real fundraising power, and a donor network that believed in them before the political establishment caught up. That's why EMILYs List exists. And from the very beginning, this work was about people willing to invest early —people who understood that money is not just money in a campaign. It is credibility. It is staff. It is voter contact. It is the difference between being written off and being taken seriously — between winning and losing. With just 15 days left until Election Day, we are all gas, no brakes. This is a time where I need to call on supporters like you to make a critical final investment in our work to make sure our women have what they need to win. = | = The history of EMILYs List matters, but I am writing today because our work and mission cannot just exist in the past. The work we do matters more than ever right now. Every day, our staff is working to recruit, train, support, and elect Democratic pro-choice women who can change the direction of this country. Our team is helping candidates build stronger campaigns. We are raising the money they need to compete. We are studying races, voters, issues, and opposition. We are communicating with millions of supporters about what is at stake. We are running paid programs to help our candidates win in some of the most competitive races in the country. And behind every email, every endorsement, and every strategic decision is a team of people who are very, very good at what they do. I will say this plainly: This is the best team in politics. I see their work up close every day. I see the long hours, the strategic thinking, the creativity, the discipline, and the urgency the EMILYs List staff bring to this fight. I see people who know that electing women is not just about winning elections – it's about changing who has power in this country and what they do with it. But talent, smarts, and strategy are not enough. To do this work at the scale this moment demands, we need resources. We need to invest in our candidates. We need to keep building the infrastructure that helps them win. We need to make sure our team has what they need to support Democratic pro-choice women in the fights ahead. That is where I'm asking you to come in. Peter,
We'll be blunt: three major stories just broke in Florida's U.S. Senate race – a must-win to hold the Senate majority. **And they 've got us on edge.**
1\. A new poll has Senator Ashley Moody at 47% and democratic socialist Angie Nixon at 45%. Two points. Inside the margin of error.
**2\. Nixon just OUTRAISED Senator Moody last quarter.**
3\. Bernie Sanders is pouring his $23M war chest into Florida to drag her over the finish line.
Any one of these would be a warning sign. **All three at once? That 's how a political earthquake starts.**
Last month, the same pollster had it 45.2% to 44.8%. Before that, another poll had it dead even, 47–47. Each one calls Florida's U.S. Senate race a coin flip.
Sure, we could make ourselves feel better by pointing to other polls with Senator Moody further ahead. But pollsters wrote Nixon off in her primary too. She was outraised 16 to 1 – and still won by 12 points. Now she's got real money behind her. The Left's money machine is lining up, and Bernie's coming with it.

| This is a longer message about my faith.

Derek, When I was 13, in a bow tie and braces, at my Bar Mitzvah, I had no idea what the next fifty years would ask of me. Here's the photo of me, in all my "glory" back then: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=10&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_101926_rs_faith&akid=10841%2E5257348%2E82Eyny) It's easy to chuckle at it now — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the look on my face — but I think about that kid a lot these days. The values I learned preparing for that morning are the same ones I lean on now: that we're commanded to pursue justice, that we don't turn away from a stranger, that silence in the face of wrong is its own kind of failure. Throughout my career in public service, I've thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of "Tikkun Olam" — repairing the world. Lately, I keep coming back to how much harder it's become to live those values out loud: watching hate rise, watching people target Jewish institutions, watching leaders who should know better stay quiet about antisemitism. I won't stay quiet. **[Before I go any further — will you chip in a few dollars to support this work? If you're not ready yet, please read on. I have more to share.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=12&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_101926_rs_faith&akid=10841%2E5257348%2E82Eyny)** | | [PITCH IN→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?t=13&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_101926_rs_faith&akid=10841%2E5257348%2E82Eyny)
---
I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the "schmata" business. He worked as a regional manager for a men's clothing company, named Farrah.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There's nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah:_What is required of us, but to do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God._**
These principles have guided my work in Congress and now in the Senate — pursuing justice, making housing the homeless a priority, fighting discrimination, and making sure the rule of law applies to everyone. They have also guided me as I stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me now, in the fight to repair and rebuild our democracy — so we leave it better for my children, and yours.
That's why I put everything I have into my work in the Senate and for the cause of our democracy. It's the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don't rest until I've done all I can for the day.

body:
Give it all we’ve got
Give it all we’ve got

| [|
---](https://go.indigenouswomenleadpac.com/f/a/oaO3uUWOq2Gx2XxYgocrug~~/AAUS1hA~/smPcssiNDo4W6pvj-pvKhvVZ4pRQRLfEV1jCQ9zaWRT5ezH1Y53i_DbXJ3KLA4YYiYZJDkgonxy9DhsbOxXHnsqk25ONWAF-AfOArvdLsHTwGbD0hPSyAGYhH6tcyXZW59ZH8sd2dKia-oYTDfE9qg~~)
| | Peter, Fifteen days from tomorrow, Americans finish voting in an election unlike any in this country's history — because of five Indigenous women on one ballot. **Mary Peltola** , a Yup'ik leader and the first Alaska Native ever elected to Congress, leads the Senate race forecasters call the "majority maker" in a state Trump won by 13. **Peggy Flanagan** , a citizen of the White Earth Nation, is in a dead heat for the seat that would make her the first Native American woman EVER in the U.S. Senate, with Minnesotans already voting. **Deb Haaland,** a citizen of Laguna Pueblo and the first Native American Cabinet secretary, is defending a single-digit lead to become the first Native American woman ever elected governor. **Sharice Davids** , a citizen of the Ho-Chunk Nation and one of the first two Native American women ever elected to Congress, is defending the seat where she made history in 2018. **Claire Valdez** , a citizen of the Ysleta del Sur Pueblo Nation and a union organizer, is ready to grow Indigenous representation in New York. All five are tied or ahead. But nothing has been won yet — and the next 15 days are when every ad airs, every door gets knocked, and every early ballot gets chased. body:
Thank you for having my back, again and again.| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141726774/654537323/-1530659900?amount=25&refcode=261019_sherrod_jared&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OGI3OTFlZC1jNWNiLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jjCz43W_iTn0SCxs77FaDdT1mvvYR4XQG_VyTGk-dXQ=)

| | | Donald Trump took the stage in Highland Heights, just outside of Cincinnati. He droned on about my opponent (if you heard what he said, you know what I mean) and attacked _**“Jared Brown.”

**_ **The name you’re looking for is Sherrod Brown. And in 17 days, I’m going to be Ohio’s next U.S. Senator.**

Look, at this point we can expect all sorts of nonsense at these MAGA rallies – and we're getting it. It’s clear that Donald Trump is taking any chance to spew lies and deceive voters to get guys like my opponent over the finish line.

But my name isn’t the only thing that Donald Trump got wrong at his rally today. He’s missing the entire point. Public service isn’t supposed to be about theatrics. It’s supposed to be about making a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

Ohioans see more money going out the door, and not enough money coming in. Gas and diesel prices are through the roof. The same pill in the U.S. costs double what it does in another country. Data centers are devouring our water and energy while Ohioans are left to foot the bill.

It’s no shock that Trump spent this rally trying to distract from real issues – issues he's had a heavy hand in creating. His accomplishments for working families or a plan to solve any of these issues? Nonexistent. He doesn’t have any record to talk about, so his rallies are packed to the brim with lies and nonsense.

Donald Trump spent the afternoon fear mongering, making up stories, and distracting, distracting, distracting. I’ll tell you now: Donald Trump has no authority to promise every American $5,000 if Republicans hold onto the Senate chamber.

To Donald Trump and Jon Husted, serving in office is just about power. If you scratch my back, I’ll scratch yours.

We need leaders who will fight to unrig this system. Right now, we’re left with Jon Husted and Donald Trump in charge.

These Trump attacks tell us that Trump is worried about us flipping this seat. He wouldn't bring Ohio up, lob attacks my way, and try to boost my opponent if he didn't think it would work out for him. So that means we have to stay focused.

**I’ll conclude this on a more hopeful note, since I’m sure you didn’t want to spend your Monday morning reading about the latest bizarre comments from Donald Trump.**

The other side is counting on schemes, outside money, and empty promises to win. You and me? We’ll win the right way – by sharing our message with as many Ohioans as will hear it.

The data shows time and again that our campaign has the momentum we need. If we can sustain it for the next 17 days, we will flip this seat. That’s the challenge ahead of us now, and it’s a big one. We’re up against $317 million of Republican spending from Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, and dark money groups. We’re never going to be able to match them dollar for dollar, but we can do enough to keep this race competitive and spread the word far and wide.

When thousands and thousands of people get involved, the effect is so much greater than one super PAC or Trump rally.

If you haven’t yet and are waiting for the best time, I hope you’ll take this as your sign to donate to my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now. | Peter,
Our grandparents marched so that Black Louisianans could have a voice in Congress. They bled for it. Some died for it.
Then the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Gov. Landry declared a "state of emergency" and canceled an election already underway, so he could erase one of our majority Black districts.
In places like Scotlandville, LA the people are losing Democrat Cleo Fields, the man who grew up on their streets and carried their voice to Washington.

I have been all over this country over the past few weeks.
Arizona. West Virginia. New Orleans. Nebraska. Wisconsin. New York. Maryland. Anywhere I've been called, I showed up. Because that's what this moment requires.
But I want to talk about something I've had to sit with and wrestle with through all of it. Something that had me ready to quit and say the hell with it all.
What does accountability look like now?
When I started this fight, the answer was clear. Hold accountable the people who attacked us on January 6th. My coworkers. My fellow officers. The people who bled that day. The people who are still living with what happened to them. That's where my political awakening began. That's where I stepped out from behind the badge and said I'm going to fight this.
But accountability has had to evolve. Because the goalposts keep moving. Not because I moved them. But because our institutions have failed us, have failed me.
The people who attacked us got pardons.
The Supreme Court basically declared Donald Trump a king with immunity.
The DOJ is now running his agenda for retribution instead of investigating him.
So you throw your hands up, right? You say I give up on accountability. We lost.
No.
I went and campaigned against him for the presidency. That didn't work. He won. Okay. Now what?
You shift. You find where accountability is still possible and you go there.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..siaZb0Wo-Ly_lu7KrCCgpIBs1cYt3itMrDJn2ryUyDI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221154738)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cb9f792-0d38-4164-aec8-cdd8167e17d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Right now that means going after the people who spread the lies that made January 6th possible. The people who told their constituents the election was stolen. Who stood in front of crowds and pointed them toward Washington and said your government is being taken from you. Go take it back.
Andy Biggs. That's why I went to Arizona. I hold Andy Biggs directly responsible for what happened at the Capitol. The people who attacked us believed what Andy Biggs told them. Seeing him lose is accountability. That's what it looks like now.
Tom Tiffany. Derek Van Orden. That's why I went to Wisconsin. Eau Claire. Green Bay. Milwaukee. Across the whole state. Election deniers. People with no character. And character is what this election is about.
I keep hearing people say let's talk about the issues. I agree. Healthcare. Energy costs. What it actually costs to live in this country right now. I want to have those conversations. Let's go.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..siaZb0Wo-Ly_lu7KrCCgpIBs1cYt3itMrDJn2ryUyDI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221154738)
But you don't get to have legitimate conversations about policy with people who don't accept the legitimacy of elections. You don't debate the issues with people who pointed a mob at the Capitol and then called it a normal tourist visit. Character is not a policy position you can negotiate around. It's the foundation everything else sits on.
When we stopped demanding it, we got Donald Trump. And Donald Trump cleared the way for people across this country to get elected by dehumanizing whoever they disagree with.
I think about John McCain. The woman at that town hall who said Obama was a terrorist, a Muslim, whatever it was. McCain shut it down immediately. Barack Obama is a good, decent man. A family man. He didn't agree with him on anything. But he said it.
Donald Trump would have turned that woman into a rally chant. That's what we lost.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea08e80-dfa5-48fe-b5af-cce7be4d0c7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nebraska showed me something. I was in Lincoln, in Omaha, in Hastings. Middle America. Thousands of miles from Washington and the Beltway and all the noise. Those people just want life to be affordable. They want their kids in good schools. They want to work without scratching for every dollar. They're not asking for much. They're asking for what every American deserves.
We can give them that. But first we need the right people in office.
Louisiana showed me the same thing. The community down there is doing great work. People are fired up and ready to get rid of Steve Scalise and Mike Johnson, to elect Jamie Davis and Lauren Jewett. The people of Louisiana deserve better. So do the people of every state where we're fighting right now.
Early voting is already underway. Make a plan. Drop your ballot at a secure drop box if you can. Do not trust the mail. Donald Trump has made it very clear he wants to end mail-in voting. Get out in person. Get out early. And do not be intimidated. He said he wants federal agents around polling places. You know why? Because your vote matters that much. If it didn't, they wouldn't be fighting this hard to take it from you.
We are almost through this. The only way we get through it is to keep showing up.
Subscribe to Standing Our Ground if you want to keep doing this with me.
-Harry

Folks, I'm sorry to be so blunt, but with President Trump coming back to North Carolina yet again in just a couple days for _another_ MAGA rally, I have to ask:
**[Will you chip in $5 to ensure we're ready for whatever attacks he throws my way?](https://substack.com/redirect/12d4e1e4-8a3c-4c65-a6c6-11d5106a4de0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Let me explain why your support is so important - and what could happen without it.
1\. Trump was just here last month. He's coming to North Carolina again to rally alongside my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley, and rile up the GOP base right before the election. And we've just learned JD Vance will be here _TODAY_ - to do exactly the same thing.
2\. North Carolinians are already voting. If we don't have the resources to fight back against Trump and the GOP's oncoming wave of attacks, their lies and distortions could be the last thing people hear before heading to the polls.
3\. I set a goal to raise $1,000,000 before Trump's big rally, and I need your help to reach it.**** Falling short would mean putting our chances of flipping this seat at risk - so we simply cannot let that happen.
**Thousands of grassroots supporters are chipping in today to fuel this movement. Now, I 'm asking you to join them. **
**[Will you give $5 or whatever you can today to help us reach our crucial $1 million goal, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/12d4e1e4-8a3c-4c65-a6c6-11d5106a4de0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/12d4e1e4-8a3c-4c65-a6c6-11d5106a4de0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The amount you give doesn't matter nearly as much as your contribution itself. When lots and lots of people are pitching in, it adds up fast.
Thank you,
Roy

**Monday, October 19, 2026 -**_****_
_**Yemen** : Ansarallah strike on military camp in Yemen's Shabwa kills 53, wounds at least 200. Saudi airstrike on house in Yemen kills at least 10, including five children. Egypt seeks parliamentary approval for possible military intervention in support of Saudi Arabia. Saudis and Emiratis meet amid reports UAE will resume support in Yemen. U.S. warns Americans across Middle East of possible airspace closures._

_**Iran** : Russian Foreign Minister visits Iran. Oil tanker hits naval mine near Hormuz, catches fire, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says. Pakistan suspends trade with Iran at two major border crossings._
_**Lebanon:** Israeli airstrikes, artillery, and machine-gun fire target southern Lebanon despite ceasefire._
_**U.S.** : President Donald Trump endorses Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu days before Israel's Oct. 27 election. Trump puts newly signed Russia sanctions on hold, citing national interest. FAA bars unauthorized drones along U.S.-Mexico border. Mexican man found dead at Laredo ICE facility, seventh ICE detainee death in Texas this year. Former President Barack Obama condemns Trump administration's investigation of Rep. Ilhan Omar. Trump says California officials "will all go to jail" if state counts ballots of supposed noncitizens. Texas reportedly weighed selling Boca Chica State Park to SpaceX._
_**International:** Ukraine launches 1,000+ drones at Russia; Russian strikes on Ukraine kill two. 2,400+ arrested in French protests. Rapid Support Forces attack kills at least 11 displaced people in Sudan. Albanian police attack protesters, arrest 1,000+. 19 dead, 25 injured in stampede during Hindu religious festival in Kolkata. Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi says his term ends in 2030, proposes military academy program to train future leaders. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Sen. Flavio Bolsonaro face off in debate. Mexico arrests former Chihuahua official, charges treason. Venezuelan opposition reaffirms support for exiled political figure Maria Corina Machado. Kenya reports eighth Ebola case. Fire at Canadian military base kills four, hospitalizes dozens._

* * *
# Yemen
* **Ansarallah strike on military camp in Yemen 's Shabwa kills 53, wounds at least 200: **At least 53 soldiers were killed and over 200 injured in an Ansarallah [strike](https://substack.com/redirect/24b12873-b867-4214-94af-279e8e7f2b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) targeting the Al-Alam military camp in the Shabwa governorate, according to the local government.
* Fighting is escalating across Yemen. Over the past 24 hours, the Ansarallah military spokesperson claimed Saudi forces carried out 110 airstrikes and missile attacks.
* Yemen's Saudi-backed government says its forces recaptured Sanamat and advanced toward Misrakh, south of Taiz city, following a counteroffensive against Ansarallah. Ansarallah forces have been besieging Taiz, where the UN has warned of dwindling food supplies.
* **Saudi airstrike on house in Yemen kills at least 10, including five children:** An airstrike on a family home in Yemen's Saada province blamed on Saudi-led forces killed at least 10 people on Sunday, including five children and three women, local media reported.
* Sana'a's National Human Rights Commission put the toll at 10 killed and 23 wounded, most of them women and children.
* [Footage](https://substack.com/redirect/09d350a9-b161-4df4-ba8b-00e75ad5dc61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shows men digging through the rubble with their hands. Saudi Arabia has not commented on the strike.
* **Egypt seeks parliamentary approval for possible military intervention in support of Saudi Arabia:** Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi [requested](https://substack.com/redirect/d3ffaa99-9135-4e06-93dc-8b038312dde3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an urgent parliamentary session to authorize military support for Saudi Arabia, as Ansarallah attacks on the kingdom intensify, Reuters reports.
* A parliamentary vote was initially expected Sunday, but discussions are set to continue Monday and Tuesday. Egypt previously joined the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen in 2015 but played a limited combat role.
* **Saudis and Emiratis meet amid reports UAE will resume support in Yemen:** Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman met UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Abu Dhabi on Sunday. Bin Salman [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2e381005-c10b-466d-9c54-86540329b39a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the two sides discussed "developments in the regional situation and ways to enhance cooperation and joint Gulf action."
* The meetings come amid [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/0628206a-9ee9-4b0a-ae6b-914600f74357?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the UAE has agreed to resume funding anti-Ansarallah forces in Yemen, with Saudi Arabia providing air cover.
* **U.S. warns Americans across Middle East of possible airspace closures:** The United States issued security alerts on October 18 warning Americans across the Middle East of potential flight cancellations, airspace closures, and rapidly escalating hostilities.The warnings cover Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Jordan, Bahrain, Oman, Iran, Qatar, Iraq, Lebanon, Yemen, and Israel.
* The alerts also warned that Iran and groups aligned with Tehran could target U.S. interests abroad.

# Palestine
* **UN food agency cuts Gaza aid for half a million Palestinians:** The UN World Food Programme (WFP) [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/8913933b-0aed-4c92-98ef-6f046649b534?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) major cuts in food assistance to Gaza cutting off half a million Palestinians from monthly food support, citing funding shortages.
* The agency is also halving food rations and reducing daily hot meals from 250,000 to 150,000. Those living in hard-to-reach areas, including near the Israeli military's yellow line, will receive hot meals every other day instead of daily.
* An estimated 67% of Gaza's population face acute food insecurity, including 200,000 experiencing emergency conditions requiring immediate assistance to prevent death from hunger.
* The cuts come as an Israeli blockade on commercial imports enters its fifth consecutive day, already causing a rise in the prices of basic goods, with sharp increases in the cost of flour, eggs, onions, and other staples.
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, five Palestinians were killed--four in new Israeli attacks and one due to wounds sustained in earlier attacks--and 22 injured across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* Israel killed at least 12 Palestinians, including three children, and wounded 68 in attacks across the Strip over the weekend.
* An Israeli strike on Saturday killed 14-year-old Palestinian student Mohammed Abu Hammad in the south of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza shortly after he returned from school.
* "He hadn't even been sitting in the chair for five minutes," Ahmed Muhareb told Drop Site's Mohamed Ahmed. "They fired a missile at the boy, while his schoolbag was still on his back." **Watch the dispatch from Mohamed Ahmed[here.](https://substack.com/redirect/a5e3a794-4fe4-48a2-92b3-4264a7f08a2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023, is now 74,480 killed, with 175,539 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,522 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,421, while 839 bodies have been recovered.
* **Israeli forces uproot hundreds of trees as settlers attack Palestinians across the occupied West Bank:**
* **Nablus:** Israeli settlers [attempted to storm](https://substack.com/redirect/940fc1cf-dc67-48ca-ae64-71037248499e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian school in Jalud, forcing the evacuation of students, and attacked nearby olive harvesters on Monday, WAFA reported.
* In Qaryut, Israeli soldiers shot a Palestinian in the shoulder following a settler attack.
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/f4ad76d9-3273-468a-854c-5320cb977c08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) agricultural structures, uprooted more than 300 trees, and bulldozed over 2.5 acres of farmland north of Hebron. Forces also detained a Palestinian and two foreign activists documenting a settler attack in Masafer Yatta.
* Soldiers detained teachers heading to a school in Susiya, arresting one and confiscating their vehicle.
* **Ramallah:** Settlers [set a vehicle on fire](https://substack.com/redirect/b07fdeb0-6e32-4854-95df-92c243dee96e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and attempted to burn two homes in Turmus Ayya, beating and injuring a Palestinian-American man. Another Palestinian was injured in a settler assault in Deir Abu Mashal.
* **Jenin:** Israeli forces [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/0d3cf679-bd85-4b89-9b2e-cb993573eacc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 20 demolition notices targeting agricultural and commercial structures, while settlers expelled farmers from their land in Al-Arqa.
* **Israeli settlers attack European diplomats observing olive harvest in West Bank:** Masked Israeli settlers on all-terrain vehicles [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/96bf6a37-0a00-48ed-bf16-51d5dfca5276?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) European diplomats and Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest near Taybeh, a Palestinian Christian village northeast of Ramallah, on Saturday. Diplomats from France, including the French consul in Jerusalem, Belgium, and Poland were present.
* The settlers surrounded a diplomatic vehicle and demanded ID, then pelted it with stones and smashed a window of a Belgian consulate car, according to the Israeli Army Radio. Footage shows men carrying clubs approaching the diplomats and one diplomat lying on the ground.
* The attack came a day after settlers beat and shot Palestinians and brutally assaulted Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine also during the harvest. Reporter Jasper Nathaniel wrote an account of that assault [here](https://substack.com/redirect/5512687f-b567-4787-b2bd-e4d7de949147?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* In the wake of international criticism following the two attacks, Israeli security forces said they arrested 10 suspects in connection with the violence. Israeli settlers are rarely arrested or prosecuted for attacks on Palestinians.

# Iran
* **Russian Foreign Minister visits Iran:** Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov is [visiting](https://substack.com/redirect/e927b507-0422-4ea6-9c37-d9f81aaef336?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tehran on Monday for talks on bilateral relations and regional and international developments, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said. Lavrov will outline Moscow's efforts to "de-escalate regional tensions created by the United States and Israel," according to the Russian state news agency.
* The visit follows consultations between Moscow and Washington and Lavrov's participation in a ministerial meeting with Gulf Cooperation Council countries.
* In an October 9 call between Russian President Vladimir Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump, Putin conveyed Iran's position on possible ways to resolve the conflict, according to the Kremlin.
* **Oil tanker hits naval mine near Hormuz, catches fire, IRGC says:** An oil tanker [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/2e0e0579-d9d0-465c-a673-9d2a925053b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, causing an explosion and fire in its engine room, according to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy.
* The IRGC claimed the vessel had switched off its navigation and positioning systems and was attempting to exit the strait through an unauthorized southern route.
* **Pakistan suspends trade with Iran at two major border crossings:** Pakistan [temporarily suspended](https://substack.com/redirect/7ffd9a40-cac9-49eb-8b6e-562d68043de1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) trade with Iran through the Gabd-Rimdan and Taftan border crossings, leaving hundreds of trucks carrying liquefied petroleum gas, rice, fruit and other commodities stranded on both sides of the border.
* Pakistani officials cited security concerns, smuggling prevention and administrative improvements, while Iran's Foreign Ministry attributed the disruption to "technical issues." Both countries said consultations were underway to restore normal operations.
* Following the start of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, Islamabad and Tehran introduced measures to expand cross-border commerce, including streamlined customs procedures and new transit routes. In August, both governments agreed to work toward keeping border crossings open around the clock.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli airstrikes, artillery, and machine-gun fire target southern Lebanon despite ceasefire:** Israeli warplanes [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/4e7faccf-54ca-4a7e-b4d8-6500bd3acebd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Kfar Tebnit in Nabatieh district overnight, while Israeli forces [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/3aa9c0ae-f4d0-4c51-835b-bfecaf9e1820?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a large demolition operation in Beit Yahoun and shelled the outskirts of Braashit, both in Bint Jbeil district.
* Israeli artillery also targeted Mansouri in Tyre (Sour) district, while troops opened machine-gun fire toward Beit al-Siyad and Mansouri, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* On Monday morning, Israeli troops opened machine-gun fire toward Wadi Beit Lif and Srebbine in Bint Jbeil district.

# U.S. News
* **Trump endorses Netanyahu days before Israel 's Oct. 27 election: **President Donald Trump [endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/4ac4c84b-612f-45d7-855d-7c881055f3bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Prime Minister **Benjamin Netanyahu** on Sunday, calling him "a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combating the Islamic Republic of Iran." Trump had held back on an endorsement for months, telling a Time interviewer as recently as this month that he's "not involved in politics anymore."
* In the same post, Trump again threatened to "soon finish the job" against Iran "unless they change their ways, rapidly," but said that if Israel has "anyone other than Bibi," then "America will have to do this work ourselves, and I am not inclined to do so."
* **Trump puts newly signed Russia sanctions on hold, citing national interest** : Trump [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/ee9e64cc-7b07-431c-8dad-b5cdc0455197?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an executive order Friday pausing a sweeping Russia sanctions package, telling Congress the delay was in the national interest. He signed the legislation last month, and the pause comes two days before the deadline for implementation. Named for the late Sen. **Lindsey Graham** , who died unexpectedly in July after returning from Ukraine, the bill was drafted with Sen. **Richard Blumenthal**(D-Conn.) and passed with bipartisan majorities.
* The package targeted Russian officials, banks, and the "shadow fleet" of tankers moving Russian energy. It also imposed tariffs of up to 100% on the top five importers of Russian oil or gas, with an exception for countries that import less than 15% of their natural gas from Russia and are significantly cutting those imports.
* **FAA bars unauthorized drones along U.S.-Mexico border:** The FAA is [imposing](https://substack.com/redirect/c1291e3b-bbda-4bc4-a7c5-21ffe2ee67f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a temporary flight restriction that bars unauthorized drone activity up to 400 feet above ground level, extending one nautical mile north of the U.S.-Mexico border. In April, the FAA and Pentagon signed an agreement allowing the government to use a high-energy laser counter-drone system along the southern border. The Pentagon claimed more than 1,000 drone incursions along the border each month, and U.S. security officials have grown alarmed about cartels using drones to drop drugs or surveil trafficking routes.
* In February, the FAA briefly halted El Paso's airport because Customs and Border Protection used the laser without a safety review. Days later, the military shot down a CBP drone with the laser, and the FAA expanded its restricted area around Fort Hancock, Texas.
* **Mexican man found dead at Laredo ICE facility, seventh ICE detainee death in Texas this year** : **Emiliano Andrade-Covarrubias** , 56, was [found](https://substack.com/redirect/3537e8e4-8bd6-402b-b8f2-dbdebd063433?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unresponsive in his cell at the Rio Grande Processing Center around 10 a.m. on Saturday, his daughter and Rep. **Henry Cuellar** (D-Texas) told the Texas Tribune.
* He is the seventh person to die in ICE detention in Texas this year. The Rio Grande Processing Center is managed by GEO Group, which declined to comment on the story.
* The family learned of his death through the Webb County Medical Examiner and was not contacted by federal agencies. Andrade-Covarrubias had a heart condition, diabetes, and high blood pressure, but, his daughter alleged, staff wouldn't administer his medication.
* **Obama condemns Trump administration 's investigation of Rep. Ilhan Omar:** Former President **Barack Obama** [denounced](https://substack.com/redirect/6e6e09a3-eca8-4876-9a92-c249c8f9aa95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the investigation of Rep. **Ilhan Omar**(D-Minn.) in a statement on X on Sunday. He said, "the fact that any president, or any administration, is willing to engage in such transparent efforts to intimidate someone should outrage all Americans, regardless of how they feel about Congresswoman Omar's political views." He warned that "if this becomes the new normal, there's no reason to believe it will stop with her -- or that future presidents, in either party, won't do the same."
* Federal agents raided Omar's Washington home last week and seized her phone as part of an investigation into whether she or her late father gave false information on immigration paperwork 26 years ago. The administration intends to build a case to strip her citizenship and ultimately deport her, the Wall Street Journal reported. The first Trump administration reviewed similar allegations in 2019 and found insufficient evidence for a full investigation, the Washington Post reported.
* **Trump says California officials "will all go to jail" if state counts ballots of supposed noncitizens**: Trump [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/1df9c551-7e7b-486e-b062-68cfa86e158b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Truth Social Friday that California officials "will all go to jail for a long period of time!!!" if they include in their midterm count the mail-in ballots of people the federal government claims are noncitizens. On Thursday, the Justice Department announced that it was pursuing legal action against California, after DOJ gave officials 48 hours to review the citizenship status of about 20,000 voters.
* **Texas reportedly weighed selling Boca Chica State Park to SpaceX:** The Texas Parks and Wildlife Commission [weighed](https://substack.com/redirect/034cbd8f-cb38-4054-a4f6-c0fb9acdfde9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) selling a 1,300-acre state park, the beachfront Boca Chica State Park in Cameron County, to SpaceX, Texas Monthly reported. According to a draft agenda, the commission planned to take up the sale in closed-door executive session on November 5, two days after the midterm election. After Texas Monthly inquired about the sale, a spokesperson for the commission said it "is not considering the sale of the Boca Chica property at its November meeting." She did not answer follow-up questions about the talks, **Elon Musk** 's involvement, why the agenda changed, or whether the issue is shelved. Sources said the nine commissioners, all appointed by Gov. **Greg Abbott** , could take it up later.
* Lawmakers gave SpaceX partial control of Boca Chica's beaches last year, and in 2024 the state agreed to a 43-acre swap that SpaceX later abandoned. This summer the US Fish and Wildlife Service approved giving SpaceX 715 acres of the Lower Rio Grande Valley National Wildlife Refuge for 683 acres elsewhere.

# Other International News
* **Ukraine launches 1,000+ drones at Russia; Russian strikes on Ukraine kill two:** Russia's Defense Ministry [said](https://substack.com/redirect/8a6d44b2-67e6-486f-950b-889808274ac3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it "neutralized" 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight. St. Petersburg Gov. Alexander Beglov said a "massive" strike killed at least one person and injured five. Some of the Ukrainian strikes appeared to target energy and tech infrastructure. Several residential buildings and two houses were struck. About 20,000 people lost power in the Leningrad Oblast, the region's governor said.
* In Kyiv, Russian strikes overnight killed a woman, hit a subway station, and damaged a residential building, injuring three people. Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia killed a woman and wounded at least two people, including a six-year-old girl.
* **2,400+ arrested in French protests:** Protests against education policies and the rising cost of living in France [continued](https://substack.com/redirect/7c7607e2-2147-4444-8aa6-60cb36d07c93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the weekend with some of the largest turnouts since the demonstrations began last month, with hundreds of thousands taking to the streets in some 140 cities and towns. Police have arrested at least 2,400 protesters since Saturday.
* French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said he has asked regional authorities to impose partial curfews in some cities. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez offered his resignation on Sunday but President Emmanuel Macron asked him to stay in his position to respond to the situation. Macron blamed much of Saturday's violence on "insurrectionist elements from radical far-left groups, joined by numerous criminals," he said in a televised address on Sunday. "Those who looted will have to pay for the damage, and those who sought to bring down the Republic will be held accountable," he added.
* **RSF attack kills at least 11 displaced people:** A Rapid Support Forces attack near the Chad border [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/0b70cbfa-cbf7-4ec2-9df1-c95edbc99b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 11 internally displaced people and wounded dozens more on Saturday, the Sudan Tribune reported. Most of the casualties were women and children, according to the Darfur Regional Government.
* **Albanian police attack protesters, arrest 1,000+:** Police in Tirana [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/2464ffcf-0e6c-47a1-9a4f-4bb639865e8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) what appeared to be rubber bullets at protesters Saturday outside the education ministry. The protests are focused on perceived government corruption, lack of jobs, and poor education standards. Rounds hit several demonstrators and two Reuters journalists. The chief of police did not deny using rubber bullets, saying "all means that were used were employed in a limited manner." He said that authorities have arrested 1,067 people and prosecuted 388.
* **19 dead, 25 injured in stampede during Hindu religious festival in Kolkata:** At least 19 people were killed and 25 were injured in a stampede at a Hindu religious festival in Kolkata, India, on Saturday. Police said a crowd outside a pavilion took cover from rain, and that some worshippers fell in the rush and were trampled. Victims were taken to Kolkata Medical College, according to Suvendu Adhikari, the head of West Bengal province. A seven-year-old girl was among the dead.
* **Sisi says his term ends in 2030, proposes military academy program to train future leaders:** Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi pledged on Saturday at an Egyptian Military Academy graduation that he would leave office after his term ends in 2030, calling it "a matter that has been completely settled and will not be discussed," and reiterated that the constitution will not be amended again.
* Sisi, 71, was reelected in December 2023 to a six-year term, after amending the constitution in 2019 to extend presidential terms from four to six years and permitted him to run for a third term. In the past two elections, several opposition candidates have been jailed or barred from running. A former army general, Sisi became president in 2014, a year after toppling elected president Mohamed Morsi.
* Sisi also announced a plan for his succession, saying that only candidates aged 40 to 50 with a doctorate should apply and would be required to spend 30 months at a military academy training program.
* **Lula and Bolsonaro face off in debate:** Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Sen. Flavio Bolsonaro [attended](https://substack.com/redirect/72b2237d-d709-4525-9b3d-ba868542ff01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their first face-to-face debate Sunday, a week before the October 25 runoff election. Bolsonaro finished nearly two points ahead of Lula in the first round of voting. According to a new [poll](https://substack.com/redirect/7875e74e-cfb2-463a-bd85-9a51ab534834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Bolsonaro only leads Lula 46.5% to 45.9%--well within the poll's margin of error.
* **Mexico arrests former Chihuahua official, charges treason:** Mexican authorities [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/3ca51109-1a29-4757-96a1-7a5e006793d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Cesar Jauregui, Chihuahua's former attorney general, on suspicion of treason, Attorney General Ernestina Godoy said Saturday. Prosecutors say that earlier this year, he allowed U.S. agents to take part in an "irregular" raid on a suspected drug laboratory in the border state without the required legal authorization. In April, the U.S. said that two embassy employees in Mexico City had died. Reuters reported that they were CIA officers.
* **Anti-corruption lawyer shot dead in Guatemala City:** Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa, an anti-corruption lawyer and former prosecutor, was shot and [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/9334e9e3-bb83-455b-8586-994e0d3a60cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a sports center in Guatemala City on Saturday, Reuters reported. Police said that they detained two men and seized a carbine-style firearm and a motorcycle in connection with the case.
* Solorzano Foppa led criminal investigations in the Public Prosecutor's Office, and later led the federal tax authority, prosecuting dozens of powerful business figures and recovering unpaid taxes. In 2025, he alleged links between the Barrio 18 gang and the right-wing political party National Unity of Hope. He also reported connections between criminal gangs and the judicial system.
* **Venezuelan opposition reaffirms support for exiled political figure Machado:** The Venezuelan opposition coalition known as the Unitary Democratic Platform [agreed](https://substack.com/redirect/f33bb405-7cfd-4680-96f1-c5b6cd627641?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to "recognize and support the leadership of Maria Corina Machado" and renewed their demand for "free elections" in the country on Sunday. Machado has lived in exile since December, and her party says Venezuelan authorities have blocked her repeated attempts to come back. Machado told the Financial Times she wants elections to be held by July next year.
* **Kenya reports eighth Ebola case:** A middle-aged man tested positive for Ebola, Kenya's Director-General for Health Patrick Amoth [said](https://substack.com/redirect/3fb3a56e-613f-43ad-8e7a-b5648863f750?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday, bringing the tally of infections to eight. Amoth added that the man was likely exposed to Ebola by Kenya's patient zero, who had arrived from Democratic Republic of Congo earlier this month. Congo reports over 9,400 Ebola cases and over 4,500 deaths.
* **Fire at Canadian military base kills four, hospitalizes dozens:** A fast-moving grass fire [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/87988979-4bd4-48e8-a45d-93cb0dee3e76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) four service members at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, Canada, on Saturday. At least 39 additional people had been hospitalized by Sunday, and at least 19 were in critical condition, according to Alberta Premier Danielle Smith.
