name: Ahlers for Governor
subject: The Election is here! Now is your time to make a difference!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DAN AHLERS FOR GOVERNOR
body:
|
---
| |
---
| | | |
---
| | | |
---
| |
---
Mitchell Forum

Last week I was happy to attend a forum in Mitchell’s famous Corn Palace. It was an exciting day as I was joined by so many excellent candidates: Margaret Kuipers, Frank Kloucek, Tom Cool, and Nikki Gronli. These candidates are all putting on good campaigns and have a great shot with your support this November.

A concern we’ve been hearing from across the state has been the building of data centers. These facilities require immense resources and the use of eminent domain to build a facility that will likely become obsolete in the near future. That’s why I will support a moratorium on the construction of data centers and remove private companies’ ability to use eminent domain.

| | |
---
| |
---
Hispanic Heritage Month

Last Friday I visited the South Dakota Hispanic Chamber of Commerce’s Latino Business Expo and Job Fair at the Coliseum in downtown Sioux Falls.

There was a variety of different Hispanic-owned businesses that showcased their products and services. For example, I was able to meet with a young woman who had just started her own catering business. There was also an opportunity to learn about different cultures and their respective dances. These small businesses and the people who run them are the lifeblood of our communities in South Dakota. It was a great opportunity to meet some of the people who make our state great.

| | | |
---
| |
---
DSU & DWU Homecoming Day Parades

Dakota Wesleyan and Dakota State both held their annual homecoming day parades this last weekend. I walked in DWU’s energetic Blue and White Days parade with my son and enjoyed a few conversations with people from the Mitchell area.

In Madison, the DSU Trojan Day parade was similarly spirited. So many people come together to celebrate their community and students, which is what makes these sorts of events so energizing.

Both schools had games after the parades. These promising students displayed their hard work throughout the season, showing us why it is important to invest in our great states public universities.

| | |
---
| |
---
Native American Day Parade

The 9th Annual Native American Day Parade was held Monday on Phillips Avenue in Sioux Falls. Native American Day is a good time to recognize and honor the essential roles that Native Americans have played in American history and society. So many local legislative candidates, including myself, came to celebrate this great holiday.

The energy was incredible. It was exciting to see the city of Sioux Falls come together to celebrate. I enjoyed being able to talk with members of the community and hear their opinions, but I had some trouble keeping up with my float!

| | | | The election draws near.

---
Here’s how we win:

Five votes. That’s all it took to change the outcome of a Sioux Falls mayoral election. After the 2026 runoff, the final margin between Christine Erickson and Jamie Smith was just four votes after the recount. Think about that for a moment. Five more people voting for Jamie Smith could have changed who became mayor of South Dakota’s largest city.

We can change all of this in November. We can elect leaders who listen to the people, respect the will of voters, and understand that government is supposed to work for all South Dakotans. But it starts with showing up. Our polling numbers are really good. If Democrats show up, we can win this race.

The best way to get Democrats to show up is to go out and ask them personally. Volunteer canvassers and phone bankers are what got Jamie so close to winning in Sioux Falls. For a grassroots campaign like this to win a state like South Dakota, we need you to show up. Volunteering to talk to your neighbors has been proven to win races because personal experience moves people.

If you want to help me win, I encourage you to sign up to volunteer. Together we can make a difference and change South Dakota for the better.

| | | [VOLUNTEER!](https://us.list-manage.com/UM6cdgZNCaq?e=cee7b49c04&c2id=3adc23449cf80dcda430cceaf3c4b05d)
---
On the Campaign Trail

| |
---
Here’s the latest from across the campaign trail—key updates, major milestones, and where we’re headed next.

| | | | | |
---
What’s Next

10/24 Viking Days and Hobo Days parade

Come see us in the parade!

10/24 Door-Knocking Day of Action

Door-knockers needed!

After Augie and SDSU’s Homecoming Day parades, come to 1737 S Cleveland Ave. Sioux Falls, where we will hold a door-knocking day of action!

Hear from the candidates and make a change in your community.

This campaign is powered by South Dakotans.

Let’s keep building this, together!

**Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._

clean_body: I’m a combat veteran and a father. I hope you will read this.| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming November 3rd election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. CA-45 is one of the seats national Republicans need to flip to maintain full control in Washington -- and after I won this district by just 653 votes in 2024, they've made no secret that they're coming after it harder than almost anywhere else in the country. Friend,

We are officially 15 days from the election, but we are not quite where we hoped to be with our fundraising. Before I personally ask you to chip in [**$3**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141754657/654626143/-224335339?refcode=em-10.19.26-all-r&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk1MzBlNDYtZjFjYi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=lvlfI9ZMVlBlsFLGXHp_gcJqCJwwM4Dmq2qrfUp1KUM=) toward re-electing the first woman to ever represent CA-30, I need to make clear why this matters right now.

That’s why in Congress, just as I did in the Assembly, every vote I make is grounded in whether or not it truly meets the needs of this district, of each of you.

I’ve championed bold policies to create more affordable housing, protect our vulnerable communities, and make the country follow California’s model for environmental sustainability and clean renewable energy, even as deep-pocketed special interests have fought us.

But in a post-_Citizens United_ world, I cannot do this alone. And every seat we can flip in Washington will go a long way toward winning even bigger battles.

Remember: Action is the best antidote to anxiety. And we all can play a part however we’re able.

That’s why I need to ask today:

## _**Welcome to the Blue Letter! Here 's 5 stories I'm watching worth your attention today**_
_Plus a few headlines to keep an eye on this week. Let me know what you think by responding to this email or joining us for a live show soon.**Have a great start to your week!**_
* * *
### 1\. The U.S. is sharing intelligence with Ukraine again. What happened?
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the U.S. has resumed intelligence-sharing after a "pause" that deprived Ukraine of information it uses to defend innocent civilians from the barbaric Russian missile attacks targeting them. _The Trump administration claimed intelligence-sharing had continued_. But Zelensky's a man who could've escaped Ukraine when Russia first attacked, yet said his fate would be the same as that of his people. Trump's a bone-spur-brained coward, convicted on roughly the same number of felony counts as Meyer Lansky, Al Capone and John Gotti combined. So I think I'm gonna take Zelensky's word for it on this one.

_Donald Trump_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=221037125&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjIxMDM3MTI1LCJpYXQiOjE3OTI0MzgyMzcsImV4cCI6MTc5NTAzMDIzNywiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.q0JPRGN-e2ocZo9_wmUQMMNKGX06inMgwOYTI--xSBk)
**Why I Care:** When Trump decides not to share intel about attacks with Ukraine, as Russia and Ukraine expert Olga Lautman said on our weekly show _World War Next_ last week, "Ukrainian civilians lose their 15-minute-advance warning. And they die." This is not just a diplomatic back-and-forth. _It 's murder_. There is no other appropriate word for purposely allowing civilians to die you could save with a phone call.
So I want to know what actually happened here, who "paused" the sharing of vital, life-saving information, and whether Kyiv can count on the U.S. going forward. My guess is Zelenskyy can count on Trump's word about as much as any creditor, wife, business partner, or diet could rely on Trump's continued loyalty.
### 2\. Republicans are moving their money out of NC. What does this tell you?
The leading Republican Senate super PAC has pulled its TV advertising in North Carolina to shift resources toward states such as Iowa and Kansas. Democrat Roy Cooper is making affordability and his Medicaid expansion as governor key campaign planks. But let's put that aside for a sec, and be real, folks. As I so often say from my time in this business: _I 'll always put my faith in good candidates_. Roy Cooper's run five statewide races (three for attorney general, two for governor) in North Carolina. At least three were when it was more red than its current purplish tint. He won 'em all.
Cooper is a great candidate. And Trump, who may not technically be on the ballot, is a narcissistic jackwad who's refused to exit the spotlight. This choice, to largely make the midterms a referendum on him, is a gift. Trump's approval rating has recently fallen just below rat feces. It now around where you'd expect to find approval for vomiting on yourself at a business meeting with your bosses, then bending over to clean it up and pooping yourself.
**Why I Care:** That old Watergate adage--follow the money, my friends. Campaigns can tell us whatever story they want about their confidence level, but where parties and PACs spend money is tells you the truth. So buh bye whomever's running against Cooper. I haven't even bothered to learn your name because I knew you'd lose. But be strong! I'm sure there are other grifts in your future! Maybe try selling a biblical cure for cancer via email list. Mike Huckabee did that and it only seems to have enhanced his career in GOP politics.

### 3\. Trump is hemorrhaging Mormon Voters--Why it's a BFD
Mormons were once as reliable a Republican constituency as existed. They strongly supported George W. Bush. Loved Mitt Romney--one of their own--when he was the GOP's presidential nominee in 2012. Oh how times change. Numbers from the _Deseret News_ and the Hinckley Institute of Politics show that Latter-day Saints' self-identification as Republican has dropped from roughly 70-75% in 2012 to the mid-to-high 50s. That's what we call free fall, friends. A twenty to 30 percent crash out.
Pew Research and YouGov jointly found a steady multi-year decline in loyalty of Mormons to the GOP, with increasing numbers of Mormons becoming independents or even or shifting toward the Democratic party. Somewhere, the late former Democratic Senate Majority Leader--and Mormon--Harry Reid is smiling.

Additionally, an independent is running against a GOP incumbent in Idaho, which is 25% Mormon, _and that race is competitive_.
This is part of the reason why.
Mormons are 6% of Nevada and Arizona's population, respectively. They could be the difference in Democrats' winning these crucial swing states. They're also about 5% of Montana and Alaska, which have crucial Senate and House races this year (Democrat Mary Peltola is leading Alaska's U.S. Senate race, while the rating for Democrat Sam Forstag in Montana's statewide House seat was just changed from "lean Republican" to "toss up"). Alaska's been trending Democratic. Mormons are a part of this equation.
### 4\. Iowa Democrats aren't trying to win every rural voter. They're trying to lose by less.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/65add8b9-d7b4-42bd-a637-f9f00dfe42d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Iowa Democrats are making a real push to compete in rural parts of the state, with candidatesl including U.S. Senate candidate Josh Turek and Iowa governor candidate, Rob Sand, focusing on local campaigning and economic issues. It is a _**smart**_ move.
**Why I Care:** Politics isn't always about persuading voters to switch sides. Sometimes it's convincing enough folks to stay home less often or give a Democratic candidate a second look. Democrats don't need to--and won't--turn every rural county blue to improve their chances statewide. _They just need to compete_. Go into these areas. Talk to folks about what's important to them.
We've seen Trump increase his vote share among groups where it was once thought to be impossible: Latinos; young, college-educated white men, etc. The dumbest thing Dems have done in 2 decades was shuttering former DNC Chair Howard Dean's _50 state strategy_. It had Democrats talking to voters year-round--in difficult regions of oft difficult states. The only way to defang the Fox, Sinclair, and talk radio lies is to show up--and show rural voters you're a 3-dimensional human. Get to know them.
So good work, Iowa! This is how you win not just this year, but in many future cycles.
### 5\. Trump's golf-course plans have a problem: a judge.
Trump has announced that East Potomac Golf Course will close on November 15 for 15 months of redevelopment. A judge has already halted redevelopment until at least October 26. The announcement doesn't establish that the administration has resumed work in violation of the court's order, but the legal dispute over the public course goes on, because can Donald Trump ever just walk away from a needless fight and not be an asshole? Rhetorical, folks.
**Why I Care:** This is about more than golf. It's about public land, who gets to make decisions about it, and stopping Trump and other Republicans from selling off beautiful public spaces to the highest, scammy, crypto-bidder. It's important that when this dingbat's plans run into courts, some courts still stand tall.

As a college football player, Jon Husted knows how to have his head in the game, both on and off the field.
That's why he turned down an offer to coach college football and instead chose to pursue a career in public service. Now, as a U.S. Senator, he's fighting hard in Washington for the values that matter most to you: hard work, personal responsibility, family, faith, and a love for America.
He's working tirelessly to create jobs, cut taxes, and make Ohio the best place to learn and start a business. He's made it his mission to defend the rights of women, children, and the unborn. And he's fighting to ensure that everyone-even the underdogs, the outsiders, and the voiceless-can achieve their own version of the American Dream.

Democrats are not just playing defense this cycle. I refuse to let that happen here.

Kurt Alme is exactly the kind of candidate Montana needs - a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor with a real record of results. He took on cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals as U.S. attorney. He cut Montana's income tax rate. clean_body: Democrats are flooding red states with outside money. Montana cannot be the one that slips away. | FROM THE DESK OF SENATOR JOHN THUNE: I want to be direct with you about something I am watching closely. Democrats are not just playing defense this cycle. They are on offense - targeting red states they have no business competing in, flooding them with outside money, and running candidates specifically designed to fool voters into thinking they are getting a moderate when they are actually getting another loyal Schumer vote. Montana is one of those states. But I refuse to let it slip away without a fight. I have served in the Senate long enough to know how these races unfold. Democrats identify a target, recruit a candidate, and pour in millions of dollars before the Republican side has had time to build. By the time conservatives see what is happening, the gap is already significant. I refuse to let that happen here. Kurt Alme is exactly the kind of candidate Montana needs - a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor with a real record of results. He took on cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals as U.S. attorney. He cut Montana's income tax rate. He helped make Montana debt-free. He has President Trump's complete and total endorsement, and mine. But here is the reality. Schumer has two candidates in this race, both funded by out-of-state money, both running the same bait-and-switch playbook we have seen in state after state. They are not running to represent Montana. They are running to give the Senate back to Chuck Schumer. Fellow Conservative, maintaining our Senate Republican Majority is not just about this seat - it is about our ability to confirm conservative judges, advance President Trump's agenda, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. Every seat matters. This one especially. I hope we can count on you. Thank you, - John Thune P.S. Democrats are targeting Montana because they think they can flip it. | | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

Friends,
With early voting underway in Kansas and Election Day just over two weeks away, Roger Marshall is _panicking_. After all, Roll Call named him one of the most vulnerable senators in the country and _multiple_ election experts have switched this race from a safe seat to a toss-up.
And you know what? He has reason to be anxious. After turning his back on Kansans and consistently voting to make their lives harder and more expensive, people are fed up. They're ready for a leader who will listen to them and work to solve their problems, not be a yes-man to a party and an administration that doesn't put hardworking Kansas families first.
But Sen. Marshall has what he's hoping is an ace up his sleeve: **President Trump is coming to Kansas tonight to hold a rally supporting Marshall.**
The president coming here so close to Election Day is proof positive that Washington insiders are worried. _They know people are fed up, they know our grassroots movement is surging and they know we have what it takes to win._
**But folks, I 'm worried too.** When the president rallies for someone, big money often follows. Top GOP super PACs have already spent millions of dollars on this race, and after tonight, they're almost certainly going to pour _even more_ resources into defeating us.
**They 're pulling out all the stops because they know that, unlike me, Roger Marshall is a yes-man for party bosses. He's spent a decade in Washington rubber-stamping the policies his party has told him to support, even when those policies hurt the people he was elected to represent.**
In the past year alone, he's voted to slash the healthcare assistance that thousands of Kansans rely on. Supported Medicaid cuts that have put 28 rural hospitals at risk of closing. Backed a war that's driven diesel prices to record highs. And signed off on the tariffs that cost Kansans hundreds of dollars every month.
**Now, the establishment is going all out to save this seat for him so he can keep putting Washington insiders over Kansans.**
Look, the reality is that we have what it takes to retire Roger Marshall. If we didn't, the president wouldn't be coming here to try and rescue him. But that doesn't change the fact that Marshall and his allies continue to outspend us at an alarming rate. They're blanketing the airwaves with attack ads against me -- and if we can't find a way to keep up, we may lose the chance to defeat Marshall and flip this seat.
I know Kansans are ready for change. I know their enthusiasm for better leadership -- leadership that actually fights for _them_ -- is surging. But if we can't keep ads on the air and fund our get-out-the-vote efforts, we'll lose ground in this critical moment ... and we won't have time to make it up.
**My team and I have set a rapid-response goal of $250,000 to help us meet this moment. That 's what it will take to respond to the escalated attacks that are coming. So, I'm personally asking: [Will you chip in whatever you can right now to help us reach our goal, get our message out there to every Kansan and flip this seat?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d2d0bc65-bfec-4f8b-9595-84834a69ba2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d2d0bc65-bfec-4f8b-9595-84834a69ba2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They're scared they're going to lose their yes-man. With your help, we can prove them right.
Thanks for all you do,
Adam Hamilton

body:
Derek, I’m inviting you on an all-expenses paid trip to meet me. [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89216?t=1&akid=9964%2E22930333%2E6Ttbg_)
---
Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to flip Congress in 15 days. If you'd like to stop receiving emails about this contest, please [click here.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/warren-sweepstakes-2026-opt-out/?t=2&akid=9964%2E22930333%2E6Ttbg_) | [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89216?amount=7&refcode=em_20261019_9964_fr&t=3&akid=9964%2E22930333%2E6Ttbg_)
---
**Derek, I’m inviting you on an all-expenses paid trip to meet me in Boston or DC.**[**Chip in $7, or any amount, to the DNC and you’ll be entered to win a free trip to meet me for you and a friend.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89216?refcode=em_20261019_9964_fr&amount=7&t=4&akid=9964%2E22930333%2E6Ttbg_)
**[Enter to Win](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89924?amount=7&refcode=em_20261019_9964_fr&t=5&akid=9964%2E22930333%2E6Ttbg_)**
I’ve been doing everything I can to make sure Democrats win back majorities in the House and Senate this November, and as a member of the DNC’s Grassroots team, I know you have been, too. That’s why I want to meet you to say _thank you_ for all that you do.
**If Democrats win back our majorities, we can stop congressional Republicans from enabling the president.**
**We can block any far-right, extremist judge that Trump nominates to the Supreme Court.**
**And, critically, we can use those majorities to actually pass policies that you will _feel_ in your day-to-day life.**
I’ve done my homework: there is a narrow path to retake our majorities in Congress, but it can be done. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141757046/654634574/-1024831887?refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6883&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mzg2ZjFhOC1mN2NiLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JjTBeRia97VvtjdzDrPREZFGPhXEY_hygETvQ6TeMKM=)

I didn’t plan on writing this, but you deserve to know what our campaign is facing. Unfortunately, this one isn’t going to be good news.
You might be surprised to hear that our Google and Facebook ads account for 25% of our total online fundraising every week. We have a massive digital outreach program, and they’re one of the best ways we can mobilize supporters and ensure folks can easily engage with our campaign.
We saw a strong surge of support around our final FEC deadline on October 14, but this weekend, our ads hit a wall.
We only brought in half of the revenue we were expecting from Google and Facebook. It looks like our ads were running properly, so we’re still digging in to see what happened. We’re learning more in real time, but here’s what we know for sure: **we have a major budget gap on the same day we have to wire TV stations in Ohio for this week’s set of ads.**
Look, asking for money is my least favorite part of running for Senate, but that’s what I need to do. If we can’t make up for our weekend fallback, we will have to scale back on our TV program at the worst possible time (just 15 days out from Election Day). Republicans outspent us by $10 million last week and Ohioans are already voting early. I need your help so we can continue sharing our message.
I’m proud of this team we’re building. We’re leading the charge to do something remarkable and flip this seat. I’m always going to lead with honesty – and I won’t sound the alarm unless it really matters.
**This is one of those times.**
We can win this race, but we can’t take it for granted. When one part of our program misses the mark, we need supporters like you to step up to make up the difference.
**[If you can chip in to help my campaign make up for this setback, it’d mean a lot to me. The big money against us is loud, but it isn’t unbeatable. At the start of his race, Chris Pappas’ was polling in the lead as high as 7 points. Then John Sununu jumped in with the full backing of Donald Trump. And now, Elon Musk has started dumping money into this race to try to flip this seat red.

Now, polling has Chris Pappas behind John Sununu, 45-43, and Cook Political Report’s downgrading of this race from lean Democrat to toss-up is proof that the tides are turning, and not in our favor.

Chris Pappas is a dear friend and colleague of mine. Having him in the Senate will be a win for New Hampshire families. If Chris Pappas loses, New Hampshire families lose too. And flipping the Senate blue becomes almost impossible.

Chris is committed to lowering costs, protecting access to health care and improving our economy, so that we all have an opportunity to thrive.

I know firsthand just how close elections can get in our state. I won my first Senate race by just 1,017 votes. When the margins are that small, every door knocked, every voter reached, and every grassroots donation can make a difference.

Chris is facing a neck-and-neck race against John Sununu, and New Hampshire is being pummeled with outside money and attack ads. Republicans are investing in this race because they think they can win.

**We have to fight and prove them wrong.**

body:
Not just another politician

| Peter,
We are sitting on the precipice of something political commentators and media critics swore was impossible.
We’re less than 20 days away from an opportunity not only to hold our House and Senate Majorities - but also to expand them.
We have a rare, historic chance to solidify our conservative agenda for years to come.
But history is not written by wishful thinking; it is won in the trenches of the most competitive districts in America, like Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District.
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._7h0kQ)[And right now, the far Left is deploying every resource they have to make sure we fall short.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/LXCzj6yMmWlhQ4F_LjcMIw)

---
The Democrats are pouring MILLIONS of dollars into key swing districts across the nation, aiming directly at the seats that stand between a conservative majority and total liberal control.
Right at the top of their target list: Jen Kiggan’s seat.
I was just on the ground in Virginia Beach with Congresswoman Jen Kiggans, and I can tell you firsthand: the Democrats are spending BIG to take down Jen.
---
| [<< SUPPORT JEN KIGGANS >>
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/pkFiQNR2FtuY-eQgNpTbCw)

](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/0dfsbMPBiqDyJ8YNsyr75A)
---
Jen is not just another politician in Washington. She is one of the toughest, most principled fighters in Congress. As a former Navy Helicopter Pilot, a board-certified Nurse Practitioner, and a Mother of four, Jen knows what it means to serve and lead.
That is precisely why National Democrats are terrified of her.
Make no mistake: the Democrats know that if they can take down Jen in Virginia, they can shatter our House Majority and halt our momentum in its tracks.
We cannot afford to let them outspend us in key battlegrounds, nor can we sit back while a veteran, Mother, and strong commonsense conservative leader, like Jen, gets overwhelmed by dark-money Super PACs.
If we win in Virginia-02, we can protect the House Majority.
This is about far more than a single district in Virginia; it is about drawing a line in the sand to defend the future of our conservative movement. But Jen cannot fight off this multi-million-dollar onslaught alone. She needs grassroots conservatives stepping into the breach with her today.
[The Left is already placing its bets. Will you help us prove them wrong?](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/UX5NnOitIwsP7n9YGoLElA)
We need 500 dedicated conservatives to chip in right now to bolster Jen’s defense fund, counter the Democrats’ attack ads, and safeguard our House Majority before it is too late.
---
| [<< I WILL BE ONE OF THE 500 JEN NEEDS >>](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/6XEFOlUKswbIzGDNju6eJw)

| [<< I WILL CHIP TO DEFEND VIRGINIA-02 >>
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjEwMTlfVUktSTAuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDYyNjMwLTIwNjgmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMDE5X1VJLUkwLjExMDExN190MjA2MjYzMC0yMDY4In0/KAbF-8HhdVsr9jnAy8NHnQ)

Thank you for being a great Patriot!
\- Speaker Mike Johnson

I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success!

As a scientist, I know you don’t test a powerful technology by trusting the people who profit from it to tell you it’s safe. You need independent oversight, transparency, and rules with teeth. subject: Rural voters are starting to turn
body:
And they're telling us exactly why

| |

Peter, Rural voters are starting to turn on Trump and Republicans. Groceries are more expensive. Prescriptions are harder to afford. Local hospitals are closing or cutting back. Farm economies are being squeezed by tariffs. The promises of bringing back the good jobs haven't materialized. And when people in these communities look around after years of Trump-era policies, they're not seeing a quality of life that's improving — they're seeing one that's getting harder. For Democrats, this is a real opening. But openings only matter if we show up. **Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_
[**Eventually, this led me to apply to West Point, and my decision to serve my country would make me the man I am today.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=e29459e38b284f92b50718b770fb08e9&_e=ZkY5jO03qxEoRdxO6OmhQq2hJo3_39kK2RsEtUbnQNdGXH5PTm7URBtLwLUdACXkqsmSbn7gLaWPtBngkZjgeW7NmUdX88v93vGWLkn50d0p1jqrrpGOhRnA99_EkTg7U4FG8r_NiXBZcSMM6KZSnrJfxS-RxIIGnp4GOwmYourMJPM6EPUvBa_vFzJ7-uvdW0-uXW7iLW_QYn80p_Ano1zFN8ZlR9qzNcZkEpBo0LuO573bGqtnwel14UjVk99rur8AJvKA1KLWYole_i5bE6z8oQPeBRPlBST9XavSa5MfXLbiW8sGNmTfRl4YRlkDN_uDgAhmoJL5-7CfQuZy1U6HijAtRfV379wwuZqRDxpWXyyFXYGoQzsxDJkMdSzitD9alp2lKOTHAEnD8VDrmm9BUPLkGXuBu35jbUu_z1CsqluWxJoEVFiG3JEt6bxX9UtvFBvSPragVjsGFPFq4BQrg4xSTqLa1aViOwDpjnWkQd_xNe5UqVsT3K65sGjpUHBn_biB2nmIesTuD04BcGTwxwj6YBOpz2elm7aFTJzKG1htnwM2kyD3sotBNu0uF6dsHOpzifplf5Up-Fd4vfSYpN8aEI78FucPL-dG8oH69TNgutl5MV9ncfcDBMC1Pi_kUnmxQ0eb_UELQcBsFZ4Ef3asQQoKbcMsYaRzRmZq80cFvylOahj9xN0O5Gq07I_-TN_qIakpTD8I6pHYM727_o_GGCqHRQxMKh7XtA3gW--Q1WhBr4NRIUnzVWND)

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, **_I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. _**
I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician...

clean_body: My story as a black Republican combat veteran| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. - After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... - These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming November 3rd election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. Peter, This weekend I had the honor of opening for James Talarico at his rally in Plano. I asked that crowd what I would ask you at your doorstep. **_Are we tired of being ruled by bullies and bigots, by fraudsters and felons? _** That crowd roared its answer, a thundering yes. And that same answer is rising from Texans of every political stripe across this state.

Texas Democrats are leading in nearly every statewide contest for the first time in most of our lifetimes.
But polls don’t vote, people do.
And James has said it himself:
Collin County is the key to flipping Texas.
80% of our district’s vote comes from this county, so every door we knock, and every voter we turn out for TX-03 feeds the same count James needs to carry the state.
At this weekend’s rally, James called Collin County his “slingshot” in the fight against Goliaths. And he is right on the money.
That makes your support a twofer in the fight against extremism.
Supporting and volunteering for this campaign retires Keith Self and powers the turnout that takes down Ken Paxton.
America was never made great by pushing people down and pushing people out.
We have 15 days to prove it.

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch Sues State Department for Records Related to Imprisonment of American Jimmy Wilgus in Russia
body:
Judicial Watch announced that it filed a second Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. State Department seeking records about the department’s failure to designate Jimmy Wilgus, an American citizen sentenced to 12.5 years in a Russian penal colony, as wrongfully detained (Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of State (No. 1:26-cv-03551)). The lawsuit seeks records under Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s leadership.

Case File No DRT-ED-BEHIND · Special File · Behind the Explosions
The War With Iran Has Lasted Almost Eight Months. The Headlines Show the Strikes. They Don’t Show What’s Being Fought Over.
Since February 28, the U.S. and Iran have traded strikes, ceasefires and new attacks. Brent crude is above $100. Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz is down more than 40%. Reports say the Pentagon is preparing new targets. Most coverage stops at the explosions. The more important story is what sits underneath them.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Wars are rarely about just one thing. The cameras show missiles, smoke and damaged ships, because that’s what can be filmed. What can’t be filmed is often more important: the resources, routes and technologies that make a region worth fighting over in the first place.
The evidence board
| | Eight Months of Conflict
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the start.** U.S. and Israeli strikes began on February 28, 2026, and killed Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Fighting has flared repeatedly since, including new U.S. strikes in July and at the end of August after attacks on tankers.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the choke point.** According to Kpler data, the seven-day average flow through the Strait of Hormuz has been about 43% below pre-conflict levels. On October 6, only seven commodity ships passed through.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — what’s next.** In early October, reports said the Pentagon was identifying targets in Iran, with potential operations including energy, infrastructure and nuclear sites, possibly after the November elections.
| OUR THEORY
---
Oil is the obvious part of the story, but it isn’t the only one. A conflict this long and this costly usually has strategic goals that go beyond what’s said at press conferences. The investors who understand those goals early tend to see the opportunity before the headlines catch up.

| | | | JoCasta Zamarripa is a lifelong Milwaukeean, a proud daughter of the city’s south side, and a dedicated public servant who’s never stopped fighting for working people. Born and raised in the very neighborhoods she now represents, JoCasta has spent her life pushing for progress that reflects the realities of everyday Wisconsinites.

[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/xzLJBMKBceL?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)

She made history as the first Latina and first openly bi member of both the Wisconsin State Legislature and the Milwaukee Common Council. But JoCasta’s leadership is defined by more than her historic firsts—it's grounded in results. She served ten years in the State Assembly and is now in her second term as Alderperson for Milwaukee’s 8th District, where she’s led major efforts on affordable housing, small business licensing reform, and community development.

In 2025, she was the lead sponsor of the Housing Element Plan, a key step in addressing Milwaukee’s housing crisis by expanding affordable options and preventing displacement. Her approach is practical and persistent—building coalitions, navigating political challenges, and staying rooted in the neighborhoods she serves.

Now, JoCasta is running as a Democrat for Wisconsin Secretary of State to use the platform to fight for what matters: more funding for our schools so families aren’t forced into referenda every election, real housing relief for working people, and affordable child care that lets parents breathe.

In just a few days, Americans go to the polls, and we keep hearing the same thing from good conservatives: "My vote doesn't matter." "I'm staying home this year to send the GOP a message." We understand the anger. Republican leadership squandered the majority we gave them – AGAIN. John Thune and the establishment had the votes and the mandate, and they spent it protecting the filibuster, cutting deals with Democrats, and passing the same bloated spending bills conservatives warned them about. But I have to be blunt, because the stakes are too high not to be: **Staying home doesn't send the message you think it does.** After a lost election, the only lesson the party bosses will learn is "be more liberal." Every conservative who sits this one out makes the next Republican Party weaker, softer, and MORE establishment – not less. **The RINOs aren't afraid of you staying home. They're counting on it. What they're afraid of is you showing up and electing conservatives they can't control.** Right now, we have fighters in the battle of their lives – in RED states – and a real chance to go on offense. We cannot abandon them now: **KEN PAXTON (TX):** Ken took on the establishment and beat John Cornyn in the primary. Now the polls show a tied race -- in TEXAS. Democrats and their allies are pouring money in to flip this seat, and if Texas falls, the Senate falls with it. **ROGER MARSHALL (KS):** Kansas hasn't sent a Democrat to the Senate since the 1930s. Today, this race is a dead heat. If we lose Kansas, there's no such thing as a safe seat anymore. **MIKE COLLINS (GA):** Mike is a fighter who won a tough primary and runoff to take on Jon Ossoff, one of Chuck Schumer's most reliable rubber stamps. This is our best chance to flip a seat for conservatives. And the fight doesn't stop at the Senate. In the House, we're backing proven fighters like Scott Perry, Joe Mitchell, Nick Begich, Eli Crane, Anna Paulina Luna, and Alex Mealer – conservatives who will hold the line when leadership tries to cave. These races will be decided by a few thousand votes. Your vote and the votes of the friends you bring with you could be the difference. **The future of the Republican Party is conservative. The only thing standing in the way is a shrinking group of establishment holdouts clinging to the past, and every conservative we elect pushes them closer to the exit.** The answer to weak Republicans isn't fewer conservatives in Congress. It's MORE. Every fighter we elect is one more vote leadership can't take for granted and one more reason the GOP establishment can't cut the next backroom deal. **[It's crunch time. It's the easiest and most effective way to help them win. Then do two more things: **1\. VOTE.**

**2\. Forward this email to three conservative friends who might be thinking about staying home.** Let's make sure the message RINOs in Washington hear on November 3rd is the right one.

Every conservative who sits this one out makes the next Republican Party weaker, softer, and MORE establishment – not less. The RINOs aren't afraid of you staying home. They're counting on it. What they're afraid of is you showing up and electing conservatives they can't control. Right now, we have fighters in the battle of their lives – in RED states – and a real chance to go on offense. We cannot abandon them now: KEN PAXTON (TX): Ken took on the establishment and beat John Cornyn in the primary. Now the polls show a tied race -- in TEXAS. Democrats and their allies are pouring money in to flip this seat, and if Texas falls, the Senate falls with it. ROGER MARSHALL (KS): Kansas hasn't sent a Democrat to the Senate since the 1930s. Today, this race is a dead heat. If we lose Kansas, there's no such thing as a safe seat anymore. MIKE COLLINS (GA): Mike is a fighter who won a tough primary and runoff to take on Jon Ossoff, one of Chuck Schumer's most reliable rubber stamps. This is our best chance to flip a seat for conservatives. And the fight doesn't stop at the Senate. In the House, we're backing proven fighters like Scott Perry, Joe Mitchell, Nick Begich, Eli Crane, Anna Paulina Luna, and Alex Mealer – conservatives who will hold the line when leadership tries to cave. These races will be decided by a few thousand votes. Your vote and the votes of the friends you bring with you could be the difference. The future of the Republican Party is conservative. The only thing standing in the way is a shrinking group of establishment holdouts clinging to the past, and every conservative we elect pushes them closer to the exit. The answer to weak Republicans isn't fewer conservatives in Congress. It's MORE. Every fighter we elect is one more vote leadership can't take for granted and one more reason the GOP establishment can't cut the next backroom deal. Please contribute directly to multiple candidates with a single transaction. It's the easiest and most effective way to help them win. Then do two more things: 1\. VOTE. 2\. Forward this email to three conservative friends who might be thinking about staying home. * * *
Hey folks,
Andrew and Tristan Tate are getting desperate.
They're still behind bars in Miami awaiting their extradition hearing, their old MAGA allies aren't rushing to save them, and now their lawyer is apparently trying to drag Barack Obama into the conversation. The whole thing is bizarre, but underneath the internet meltdown is a much bigger story about power, accountability, and how these guys ever got this close to American politics in the first place.
* [**00:01:08**] Barack Obama speaks out about the Trump administration's treatment of Ilhan Omar, and the Tate brothers' lawyer immediately tries to make it about Andrew and Tristan.
* [**00:03:31**] Why I think Andrew Tate's fixation on Obama says something deeper about the persona he's spent years selling to young men online.
* [**00:06:02**] The jokes stop here. We get into the extremely serious allegations at the center of the Tate brothers' legal problems, and why their increasingly desperate PR campaign shouldn't distract from them.
* [**00:09:33**] Even Nick Fuentes admits the Tates could face enormous consequences if they're extradited, as their former MAGA allies remain remarkably quiet.
* [**00:12:47**] The question I keep coming back to: how did the Tate brothers get so close to Trump world, and did those political relationships influence how the U.S. government treated them?

This story matters because it's bigger than two obnoxious internet personalities melting down online. It's about access. It's about influence. And it's about whether powerful political relationships can help people avoid accountability while everyone else plays by a different set of rules. Democrats need to take those questions seriously, and independent media needs to keep asking them. **If you value reporting that follows the story even after everyone else moves on, help me keep doing it.**

**But, Peter, far-right Republicans in Phoenix and Washington want to destroy the cornerstone of who we are as Americans by making it harder to vote.**
They want to:
📮 Restrict access to mail-in ballots.

I've said this publicly before. _I'm saying it again because people keep treating this like some abstract concept, and it isn't. It's a woman trying to get to a doctor._ I will do whatever it takes to stop a national abortion ban, and I will fight tooth and nail for access to all reproductive care for women in this district and around the country. Every woman should be able to see a doctor whenever she wants, for whatever reason, without asking permission from a politician. My opponent feels differently. In Olympia, John Braun voted against emergency care for women having a miscarriage.**

** He voted for a bill that would let doctors who perform abortions be imprisoned.

He opposed an amendment to codify abortion rights. He voted to prevent insurance from covering contraceptives. ** ** **And he has said he wants to ban abortion statewide.** One outlet described his record as hostile to reproductive rights, and that's the plainest way to put it. These aren't hypotheticals about some future potential votes. They're votes he already took, in our state, about our doctors. We can’t let him get to Congress. On Saturday, I rallied a massive crowd in Atlanta to organize opposition to the Trump administration and my opponent, Mike Collins.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea995c6-a90b-4c5b-a951-724f4fb8d1a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
