# Drop Site Under Legal Threat. Again.
### This time it's a Senate candidate. Their deadline is tomorrow, and we're not backing down.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Oct 19
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
Drop Site is under legal threat again, and we're not backing down.
Last week, attorneys for Mike Rogers, the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Michigan, and his wife, Kristi Rogers, sent Drop Site News a letter demanding that we retract our recent investigation, and threatening litigation if we don't.
The story is headlined, "Mike Rogers's Wife Raked in Lucrative Government Security Contracts While Rogers Served as Intel Chair," and looks into contracts won by the security firm Aegis Defense Services while Kristi Rogers was serving as the head of its American subsidiary, including while Rogers was serving as chairman of the powerful House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
The letter demands that we publish a retraction, take down, or rewrite the story, its headline, and our social media posts, and preserve all of our internal communications. They gave us five days, or we face further legal action. Five days would be tomorrow, and we're not backing down.
**We stand by our reporting and will defend it if necessary.**
To be clear, this is a threat of litigation, not a lawsuit. It's a warning shot, meant to make a small, independent newsroom think twice before publishing the next story. The only answer is to show, publicly and unmistakably, that we have the resources to fight back. When thousands of readers step in to backstop us, anyone thinking about suing gets the message. They can file, but we'll be ready, and we won't back down.
_**[Show them this community can't be intimidated. Make a tax-deductible gift to Drop Site's legal defense fund.](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[DEFEND DROP SITE - DONATE TODAY](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**We 've Been Here Before**
Last year, a top BBC editor sued over Drop Site's investigation into the BBC's coverage of Gaza. The bet was that a reader-funded newsroom couldn't afford the fight.
You proved them wrong. That case is still ongoing, but we have won a major procedural victory that all but assured us we will win in the end. Your support is the reason we've been able to defend our journalism without backing down an inch.
That response sent a message that reached far beyond one courtroom - and our triumph so far has been hailed as a victory for press freedom in the UK. Now we need to send it again, louder, here in the United States, because these attacks aren't going to stop. When you expose the powerful, the powerful push back. The White House has denounced our reporting. Governments have banned us. Coordinated campaigns have called for federal investigations into our correspondents. And now a former chair of the House Intel Committee has lawyers demanding we take down an investigation into his family's finances.
_**[Help us build a legal defense fund strong enough to make them think twice. Donate today.](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
The people behind these attacks are making a calculation: if they threaten enough, sue enough and drag things out long enough, a small newsroom will eventually decide some stories just aren't worth the trouble. **The only thing that changes that calculation is you.**
Let's flip the calculation: Make the powerful subjects of our investigations understand that when they make threats like this, all it does is bring more attention to the story and leave us stronger than when we started. That's the only thing that will stop these threats and clear the path for journalism.
[SUPPORT OUR DEFENSE](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**They Have No Idea How Powerful This Community Is**
The people sending these letters have high-priced law firms, political operations and friends in power. What they don't have is hundreds of thousands of readers standing behind them.
We do.
**We answer to no one but our readers** : not corporate owners, not billionaire backers, not political parties pulling strings. That independence is exactly why we can publish stories like this one. It's also why they think we're vulnerable. Let's show them how wrong they are.
Every tax-deductible dollar you give goes directly toward:
* Legal review and defense of our reporting
* Media liability insurance
* Protecting our reporters' ability to keep investigating the powerful
* Proving that this community will not be intimidated

**We will not retract accurate reporting. We will not be bullied into silence.[And with your support, we'll have everything we need to fight if it comes to that.](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We'll keep you updated as this develops and stay transparent about what it costs. Right now, the most powerful response we can give is a legal defense fund so strong that the message is unmistakable: come after Drop Site, and you come up against all of us.
_**[Stand with Drop Site. Make a tax-deductible donation to our legal defense fund today.](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[ DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/fdae356c-4cf7-4a5e-bd07-5ea2dc92db97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They sent us a letter. Let's answer it with thousands of readers standing behind us.
(C) 2026 Drop Site News, Inc.
Drop Site News Inc., 1930 18th St NW
Ste B2 #1034, Washington, DC 20009

Thursday, October 22nd, from 3PM to 6PM \- 4029 Market Street - \- 5610 Lancaster Ave - As we continue to see attacks on voting rights and access, we encourage you to vote early at a [Philadelphia Satellite Election Office](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172592.172446.40&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18572) to skip the lines and cast your vote safely and securely. name: Tina Kotek
subject: No community should have to endure this kind of unimaginable loss
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF TINA KOTEK, OREGON PAC ID 4792
body:
Content warning: This email contains mention of gun violence.

_Content warning: This email contains mention of gun violence._ Dear Peter, All of us are shocked and deeply saddened by the tragedy that unfolded at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend last week. No child should have to experience or worry about violence at their school. No parent should have to fear for their children when they send them off to learn. And no community should have to endure this kind of unimaginable loss. My heart is absolutely broken. It will remain broken in the days and weeks ahead as we grapple with this tragedy. My daily prayers are with the victims, survivors, their loved ones, and the entire Bend community as they navigate the grief and trauma of this devastating event. I am grateful to the school staff, parents, first responders, and community members whose quick thinking and courage helped prevent further loss of life. We cannot accept this as an inevitable part of life. We must come together, care for one another, and do everything in our power to prevent another community from experiencing this heartbreak. There will be time for answering all the questions we have and searching for more ways to prevent this kind of violence from happening. But for now, let us hold each other close in our grief and put as much love into the world as possible. We must come together and support each other, neighbor to neighbor, Oregonian to Oregonian. **NHGOP Statement on FEC Complaint Filed Against Stefany Shaheen**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** October 19th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

**CONCORD, N.H.** — Today, the New Hampshire Republican State Committee responds to the FEC complaint filed against Stefany Shaheen.
“Stefany Shaheen’s lack of transparency is unacceptable,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “She knowingly hid corporate contributions on her report. She is hoping you don’t notice, bringing to light how she will be another corrupt politician if she is elected to Congress.”
“The Shaheen campaign reported a donor’s named employer and CEO title, then amended the filing to replace both with ‘self-employed.’ It already had the information. Why was it removed?” **said National Committeeman William O’Brien.** “We filed this complaint because the records show serious disclosure failures. Voters deserve to know which professional and business interests are financing the Shaheen campaign and its attack ads. The apparent concealment of those affiliations is outrageous. The FEC should determine who authorized that amendment and why. Voters deserve those answers promptly.”
_According to the complaint:_
“The Committee’s reported donor information presents occupation entries that disclose noprincipal occupation, inconsistent employment information for matching donors, and employerdescriptions contradicted by primary professional records. The Committee’s own filings contain more complete information missing from other entries.”
To read the full complaint, [click here.](https://us.list-manage.com/1AFfksVsm3a?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=rMr0rW1xMi6K_QdakNPPBRFg9FCbGXRJOE1iZDknIePFWbvWJ3xDG80fiw==)To read the story on WMUR, [click here.](https://us.list-manage.com/2s0bpfMbFUR?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=Yl-LsAPCckzpsJ8KKUsZ28rJGMRMqkMdOJAOsL87QuDtugBwU1DATSjdIA==)

clean_body: I need to be blunt with you: our democracy isn't getting saved by the end of the hour. | | | | Hi, Derek, it’s Bradley Whitford. I’m an actor, but before any of that I grew up in Madison, Wisconsin. You might know me as Josh Lyman on The West Wing, where democracy always got saved by the end of the hour. I need to be blunt with you: our democracy isn't getting saved by the end of the hour. We've seen what Wisconsin looks like when the wrong people hold the gavel: Gerrymandered maps that were locked in one-party rule for a decade. Voting rights stripped down to the studs. Health care decisions handed to politicians instead of the people who actually have to live with them. I'm not willing to watch that happen again and I don't think you are either. | | Here's what I know: Wisconsin decides things. Not just for itself, but for the whole country. Every state legislative seat, every local race, every down-ballot fight this November either builds on the progress we've made or hands it back to the same people who've spent years trying to drag this state backward. Wisconsin Democrats have proven, election after election , what's possible when people show up. Together, we’ve fought for fair maps, real accountability, and a state government that actually works for the people who live here. None of that holds without sustained, keep-doing-it support. name: Sherrod
subject: Don’t want to let you down
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Thank you for having my back, again and again.
#

Peter:
We're just under one month out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: **I don’t want to let you down.**
_You_ are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When Peter Thiel dropped $3.6 million against me in a single week, you helped keep our own ads live.
* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.
* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $30 million behind new attack ads spreading lies about me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, Peter.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to _pour_ in. **In fact, Republican megadonors are spending more here than in Georgia, Alaska, and North Carolina combined. Let that sink in.**
I’m not sharing this to scare you – the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win – but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive _only_ because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
[**Today, I’m asking you to split $10 between my campaign and Ruben Gallego. I’m counting on you. Will you give what you can to help us flip Ohio and take back the Senate?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sherrod.7OMOGL&refcode=em261019-1-90&t=1&akid=4224%2E734936%2E0CI3iA)
Thank you for keeping us in this fight,
Sherrod Brown

Honestly, friend, I'm just a kid from Youngstown, Ohio who survived some difficult circumstances. I never thought a President would say my name – _much less support my run for governor of Ohio_.
But because of this team, we've done the unthinkable. We've overcome over a hundred million dollars in ad spending against us. We've been named one of the most competitive races in the country and a true toss-up by political experts.
**We've built an unstoppable movement that is going to make a statement on November 3rd:****Ohio is not for sale.**
[If you're ready to take Ohio back for the people, I urgently need your support. We're still being outspent at an alarming rate on TV ads, and the polls show this is too close to call.](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OyEnuhS_8l82YxDzIAbC1GZNG7hgVof8zeNhjSHGg8RU_C7xXxXK0GzJVcBfWLaS2NLu6y_qo9lvWw8e2GUFkUc5tUiAKvQU3iQyMdvUgUjgmuOcX3r72-EFYsfKVGFriaGKSKK87ewj06jZhjPP9laQdA5rQ7IytA4GE6IviI4jRZS0F-Xrsc5yntt3ruqMK8kcA0rwpgngfhpP0sxnWz82yWBzqwEpcIGklgN5m0-3BacEaIOFW0NFkpWuwx_WrnbUPCZtu30=&c=-kAr4_TBmd9RFEBWp01rnUS2eKEW_jgRb2Dd2ZAwW1dYbJY0wD1csA==&ch=i6U9UVPjkQzR5LIssg_SzPpQhpkfNDmNBvAYkimhEemucKhmgv1bvg==)

**Like President Obama said, I know that Ohioans are working harder than ever and are still falling behind. That's why I'm willing to work with anyone – Republican, Democrat, or Independent – who is ready to solve the problems, not create them.**
But I want to be honest: Vivek Ramaswamy and his allies have outspent us 7-to-1 smearing me on the airwaves, and Donald Trump was _just_ in Ohio for the second time in two weeks to rally their extreme base.
**And unfortunately, it's having an impact: The latest polling shows me 1 point behind.**

name: Swing Left
subject: This is how we run up the score
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
None of what we accomplished last weekend would’ve been possible without the support of Swing Left volunteers across the country.
#
Hi there,
This past weekend was the biggest of the entire cycle for Swing Left volunteers, and it wasn’t even close.
**Between Friday and Sunday, volunteers in 33 congressional districts across 16 states—including Pennsylvania, Virginia, Texas, Wisconsin, California, Ohio, and more—showed up to knock on doors and call voters.** _All in all, we saw nearly 80% more door knocks than the week before_ , capping off our biggest week of Ground Truth canvassing to date: 13,960 doors in one week!
None of what we accomplished last weekend would’ve been possible without the support of Swing Left volunteers across the country. We especially want to highlight an incredible group of students from **Columbia University** , who joined a Ground Truth Bus to travel to Maine, stayed there through the weekend, and knocked on 6,021 doors in the process.
_
Columbia students on their second day of canvassing in Lewiston, Maine!_
And those students weren’t alone. Volunteers in Pennsylvania, Michigan, California, Ohio, Virginia, and beyond were out there with them, knocking on doors, making calls, and having real conversations with voters in this final sprint to Election Day.
_
Ground Truth volunteers on a bus to Virginia’s 1st Congressional District with Reproductive Freedom for All._
_
Ground Truth volunteers in Pennsylvania’s 10th Congressional District._
With November 3rd just over two weeks away, we don’t want Democrats to squeak by. We want to run up the score by winning as many races as possible, by as much as possible, flip the House, flip the Senate, and win key state races, too.
_That’s_ how we put a real check on Trump and his MAGA agenda.
**But this work can only happen if we all do our part. Right now, there are a few ways to help:**
* [**Use the Take Action Tool to find the best volunteer opportunity for you.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3187?t=1&akid=3209%2E1562180%2Es_9K3G) You can canvass in a swing district or state near you, or join a virtual phone bank from home anywhere in the country.

* [**Make a donation of any amount to support Ground Truth today.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-2025-sl.QSDeHu&amount=25&%3Butm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=gotv-2026&%3Butm_content=20261019&%3Brefcode=ak_em_gotv-2026_20261019&t=2&akid=3209%2E1562180%2Es_9K3G) It takes resources to get volunteers out on the doors, and we can’t do it without your help.

* Not sure where to get started? [**Join a quick half-hour Swing Left intro to get oriented to the options available, no matter where you live.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3188?t=3&akid=3209%2E1562180%2Es_9K3G)

Thank you, as always, for everything you’re doing to help Democrats win. Stay tuned for more updates over the next two weeks!
— The Swing Left Team

P.S. Swing Left’s Ground Truth program was featured in a story on Fast Company today, the result of a months-long deep dive by reporter Issie Lapowsky. [**Take a look!** ](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3189?t=4&akid=3209%2E1562180%2Es_9K3G)

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261019-1&t=5&refcode2=3209_1562180_s_9K3G&akid=3209%2E1562180%2Es_9K3G)

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: The crook President Donald J. Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3129%2E5691347%2EJgR9Tx)

On Saturday, I rallied a massive crowd in Atlanta to organize opposition to the Trump administration and my opponent, Mike Collins.
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/7468?t=2&akid=3129%2E5691347%2EJgR9Tx)
[**(You can watch my speech here.)**](https://act.electjon.com/go/7468?t=3&akid=3129%2E5691347%2EJgR9Tx)
Here's what I said:
Now, over the last year, I've been in small towns and big cities. I've been in the mountains and on the coast and on the Georgia farms that feed and clothe the whole world.
Together, we've gathered in backyards and living rooms and at rallies like this one where the crowds just keep growing and growing. And after all that, I'm here to tell you that I have no doubt our victory is near at hand.
In 17 days, Georgia, when the polls close, we'll defeat the bigot congressman, Trump puppet Mike Collins. In 17 days, our juggernaut Democratic coordinated campaign will have turned out the vote like never before to elect Josh McLaurin, Penny Brown Reynolds, Tanya Miller, and Democrats up and down the ballot across our state. In 17 days, we'll elect Keisha Lance Bottoms the next governor of Georgia.
Keisha is a mother of four, and as our governor, she'll guarantee pre-K for every four-year-old in Georgia. She'll expand Medicaid to save Georgia's hospitals and nursing homes and ensure every child in Georgia has great health care. It's time to elect Keisha Lance Bottoms our next governor and make sure no child in Georgia is turned away from the pediatrician.
And Georgia, in 17 days, we’ll rebuke the crook President Donald J. Trump with such clarity and power that no president will dare such abuses again for centuries. But between now and then, we need you to work — not for my sake, but for the sake of our state and our country.
See, some people just happen to live at times and in places where history is made. And this year, once again Georgia, that's us. So, Georgia, are you ready to work?
Now, maybe you saw Donald Trump was in Dalton yesterday... oblivious to the collapse of his presidency. A crowd smaller than this one endured two hours of senile babbling, while the price of oil hit its five month high.
Now remember, they promised to lower prices on day one. Instead, under the failed President Donald J. Trump, it costs more than ever in American history to fill up your truck, stock your fridge, visit the doctor, or power your home.
They promised to drain the swamp. Instead, it's the most corrupt administration of all time, and everybody knows it. Everybody knows it. And while the crook president and his crook family rake in billions from all over the world, you pay more for everything.
They doubled your insurance premiums and slashed Medicaid to cut taxes for the rich. They lied us into war and spent most of the last year covering up for the world's most famous pedophile.
At a rally earlier this week in Ohio, the president egged on supporters who assaulted a woman demanding the release of the Epstein files. Did you see that? Because if you can count on one thing about this White House, it's their tireless commitments to war, inflation, and covering up sex trafficking.
Now remember, they also promised peace. Instead, they plunged us into a war they don't know how to end or how to win. The biggest foreign policy debacle since Iraq and another war based on lies. Remember, last year they claimed Iran's nuclear program had been obliterated. Do you remember that? And then this year, they claimed that same nuclear program posed an imminent threat — both times lying.
And now remember, on day four of the war, the president declared victory.
On day 11, Trump said, "The war is very complete." That was day 11.
Day 13, "We won."
Day 21, "Getting very close."
Day 32, "Leaving very soon."
On day 40, the president declared "Total and complete victory."
Today is day 232.
And yesterday in Dalton, he promised again the war would be over soon. He claimed again Iran's military had been destroyed. And he said he would rename Hormuz the Trump Strait.
See, the draft-dodging president tells jokes while 21 Americans are dead and hundreds wounded. Iran still has its uranium and its drones and its missiles. Diesel's at its all-time high. 12 more ships were hit this week alone. They've drained our stockpiles to achieve nothing, while the crook Commander in Chief builds a monument to himself.
And while the world burns, in Washington and at Mar-a-Lago it's a spectacle of graft unprecedented in American history.
Now maybe you saw Trump's so desperate he's begging Putin for diesel. But listen to this: At the very same time, the White House is brokering the sale of billions in Russian energy assets to people who fund the Trump family and the Trump campaign. We're talking oil fields, refineries, gas stations all over the world to be sold to the first family's cronies in a deal brokered and backed by the U.S. government.
Y'all remember Jared Kushner? The president's son-in-law, the so-called special envoy, responsible for diplomacy with Russia and in the Middle East. Do you remember the other special envoy, Steve Witkoff, who co-founded the president's crooked crypto business, World Liberty?
Okay, so follow me through on this — what Jared and Steve are doing right now is negotiating with Putin to sell billions in Russian oil fields and refineries and gas stations to the president's friends.
You've got Sheikh Tahnoon, the Emirati spy chief who paid half a billion to the Trump-Witkoff crypto business. Then you've got the Al-Khayyat brothers, two Syrians who are financing Jared and Ivanka's multibillion dollar Albanian resort project. And then the third partner, a billionaire mega-donor to Trump's campaign.
Oh, and the U.S. government would take a 15% stake, by the way. Are you getting the picture? Amidst a global energy crisis, the president's son-in-law and the president's business partner are brokering the sale of Russian oil fields to the first family's friends. The same friends who have poured hundreds of millions of dollars into Trump family businesses.
And then there's Marco Rubio committing $1.6 billion of your money to back the Trump boys' mining interests in Kazakhstan. Did you hear about that? Pete Hegseth steering hundreds of millions of Pentagon dollars to back Don Jr.'s magnet investment. Venezuelan oil money turning up in Qatari bank accounts. Because, see, they are literally the elites they pretend to hate.
And here's the bottom line: If you're involved in any of this, next year you'll be raising your right hand and swearing to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God, in front of the United States Congress.
The Mar-a-Lago mafia really has taken American corruption to spectacular new heights. But Georgia, corruption in American politics runs a lot deeper than Donald Trump. And see, I get why people voted for him.
Because even before he came on the scene, American politics was coin-operated. Money goes in, favors come out. It's been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money. Both sides. And when members of Congress aren't fundraising from lobbyists and corporate PACs, they're trying to dodge getting bombed by these Super PACs.
Spectacular wealth buys an ever greater share of power over our national affairs. And this corruption is why nothing works for ordinary people. It's why you pay a fortune for prescriptions. It's why your insurance company gets away with denying your cancer treatment after you paid your premiums for decades.
So Trump promised to attack a broken system. I get it, ripe target. Yes, the system really is rigged, but he's not unrigging it. He is re-rigging it for himself.
And how do we unrig American politics? Well, first, follow the money. _Citizens United_ was the most destructive Supreme Court decision in modern American history. And Donald Trump's rise is a symptom. See, the crisis we must meet is deeper than this presidency.
Trump's rise is proof that business as usual has failed, that our politics, sickened by corruption, is failing the American public and compromising our national integrity, and that the hour is late to fix what's broken.
And I suspect many of you are here because you recognize that our task is not just to contain this wickedness, but to repair the brokenness beneath it. That this moment is an opening, not for restoration, but for reformation. Because who really supports allowing unlimited, secret political money to bend the nation's agenda in darkness?
In Athens or Albany or Columbus or College Park, if I ask anyone — Democrat, independent, Republican, none of the above — if I ask them whether this is how things should work, it doesn't matter who they are, the answer is no. So let the defenders of secret corporate money in politics come out and defend it. They'll lose the debate. And Georgia, if it takes a constitutional amendment to end _Citizens United_ , we’ll deliver a United Georgia to ratify it.
A United Georgia.
Every day our wave grows taller and our tent grows bigger. Because this isn't just a campaign for Democrats. Folks come up to me at airports or on the street. They tell me they're lifelong Republicans, but this year, they're voting for Democrats for the first time.
Down in Valdosta, the mayor's named Scott James Matheson, a lifelong conservative Republican. We expanded Valdosta's transit system together. We upgraded Moody Air Force Base together. When Hurricane Helene hit, I called him up in the middle of the night to check on the city, and when the storm cleared, I was there alongside him to help, going block by block. We served hot meals to folks who had just lost their homes.
When I got back to Washington, I delivered federal disaster relief for South Georgia, and now I'm honored to have conservative Republican Mayor Matheson's support in this reelection campaign.
See, just about every week, I dial up Georgia mayors and pastors and farmers to find out how I can help. One day, I called up Mayor Julie Smith, just up the road from Valdosta in Tifton. Mayor Smith's a Republican, too. She told me the Tifton hospital needed new dialysis equipment. She explained how Tifton's dialysis center serves 12 South Georgia counties, and they just couldn't meet the need.
So I delivered the funds to upgrade that South Georgia clinic, and now it can serve 200 dialysis patients. And Republican Mayor Julie Smith is backing this campaign too.
Up north in Toccoa, then-Mayor Gail Fry, another Georgia Republican, she told me Toccoa's gas lines were wearing out, and a leak could risk lives. We needed to get moving quick to replace miles of old pipes. So I delivered the funds for Toccoa's new gas lines, and Georgia Republican Gail Fry's backing this campaign too.
Because, see, hurricanes and diabetes and gas leaks don't check your party affiliation when they hit. And when it comes to serving Georgia, I don't either.
But there's another reason so many Republicans are backing our campaign, and it's the bigot Congressman Mike Collins, who's only a congressman because his daddy was a congressman, surrounded at work, at home, and on his campaign by neo-Nazis and white nationalists.
See, Brian Kemp was right about Mike. There's a reason Rick Jackson doesn't campaign with Mike. Why Brad Raffensperger refuses to endorse him. Why conservative WSB radio host Shelley Wynter called Mike a bottom feeder.
Why Coach Dooley condemned Mike's "blatant taxpayer-funded corruption," and said Mike's "disgusting behavior does not represent Georgia values or, frankly, any values."
Why Erick Erickson said Mike "knowingly hired a sociopath with a criminal record who was alleged to have used your and my tax dollars to subsidize his girlfriend."
There's a reason one of the founders of the Tea Party said this summer "I cannot in conscience vote for Mike Collins. He is unfit for office," and warned that Collins would "drag down the whole Republican ticket in Georgia."
And that reason is that Mike Collins is a known bigot under federal investigation for the illegal misuse of tax dollars, widely known for his poor character and low integrity, and unfit for any elected office in the United States. And Georgia, now the bigot wants a promotion. But this year, we'll end his political career instead.
Because in his pathetic, childlike devotion to Donald Trump, Mike Collins has sold out our state. He voted every time for the war. He voted every time for the tariffs. He voted to double your health insurance premiums and for the biggest Medicaid cut in American history.
Listen to this: St. Mary's Hospital in Lavonia is in Mike's district. And they just closed their maternity unit, citing the Medicaid cuts that Mike Collins voted for to fund tax cuts for the rich.
So now, thanks to Mike Collins, delivering mothers Mike Collins represents have to drive an hour in labor to get to a labor and delivery unit, in a state where we've already lost 21 hospitals in 20 years.
In a state where if you're born today in Georgia, your life expectancy is shorter than if you were born today in Lebanon. Where, thanks to Donald Trump and Mike Collins, and their attacks on the Affordable Care Act, 300,000 Georgians lost their health insurance this year, and a million saw their premiums double.
Now what could drive a man, even one as spoiled and hateful as the congressman's son Mike Collins, to cast votes that close a labor and delivery unit in his own district? Or double his own constituents' health insurance premiums? See, it's not just the money that's corrupted our politics, it's moral corruption. The cynical indifference of powerful people.
See, my office is known for world-class service. But what amazes me is how surprised people are to be treated well.
Nancy Lancy’s 81 years old in Jesup. Her husband died after years of dementia. She was worn out and alone. And now her affairs as a widow were all wrapped up in this bureaucratic labyrinth from the VA to the IRS and Social Security. So we took care of things for her.
And I'll never forget what she said about it. She said, "This was a new experience, to have someone caring about me." A new experience to have someone caring about me.
How has it come to pass that for so many Americans, the experience of genuine care is rare and surprising? Official indifference and corporate disrespect have become systemic when millions are just one medical bill, one short paycheck, one bad alternator from financial disaster.
You work harder and harder, but the treadmill gets faster and steeper and the bills get higher and higher. A 60-hour workweek still needs SNAP, and that bucket list trip’s off the table for good.
And then, instead of reading your daughter her favorite book, that precious spare hour after work you're on the phone begging the insurance company to cover the medicine that prevents her seizures.
The Army lost the records you need to claim your VA benefits, and it takes a year and 12 phone calls to fix it. You report the black mold to your landlord, who doesn't fix the leak, and the ambulance for your toddler's asthma is followed by a $3,000 bill.
And it's the worst for the most vulnerable. Maybe you saw my investigation of Georgia foster care. In just four years, hundreds of Georgia children likely sex trafficked in the care of our state. Many more abused and neglected. Rachel Aldridge testified about her two-year-old daughter, Brooklynn. See, over Rachel's repeated objections, DFCS had placed two-year-old Brooklynn in the care of her father and his girlfriend, despite their criminal histories.
State officials ignored Rachel's pleas. They skipped mandatory background checks. And two months later, Rachel's precious, perfect, irreplaceable, two-year-old girl was dead. When she testified before my committee, Rachel said she had flown on an airplane for the first time in her life just so she could tell Senators her story. She begged us, “Please remember Brooklynn.”
And listen to this, Georgia DFCS is so broken that when they couldn't find enough placements for kids with special needs, the DFCS commissioner tried to lock those kids up in jails for children. But the judges refused and reported it to my office.
They tried to put special needs kids in jail.
And then when my investigation brought all this to light, when we held Senate hearings and exposed it all, instead of resigning or at least leaping into action to fix it, state officials retreated into denial and PR and counterattack.
Because foster kids don't have lobbyists or a Super PAC. Neither do the women subjected to medical abuse in ICE detention. Neither do the female inmates sexually abused by the warden and the chaplain in their federal prison. Or the young military family neglected by the defense contractor with a 50-year lease on privatized housing at Fort Gordon.
But they deserve leaders who see them and expose those who abuse them, and that's exactly what I'll keep doing, Georgia, because we're all in this together.
Every day, I think about Congressman Lewis. His portrait hangs right above my desk in my Senate office. And even in his final moments, he kept reminding us that we all live in one American house, that we all live in one world house. Do you remember? John Lewis called it the inevitable truth that we're all members of one human family.
And I suspect many of you are here today because you're so deeply troubled by the pain that so many of our fellow human beings are enduring right now — the terror of a child watching ICE take away his mother, the despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment, or the silent panic of a grandmother when she sees the receipt for her groceries and then remembers there's three weeks left until her next Social Security check.
And that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, that feeling’s what reminds us that we're all in this together. That we're not just one United States, we're one united people. E pluribus unum. Out of many, one.
How inspiring that the most powerful nation on Earth proclaims as our core values that all are created equal, with inalienable rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness? Because see, Americans aren't a race. We're a people. United not by ethnicity but by shared convictions, and that is what makes us exceptional and a beacon to the world.
And see, this is what small men like Donald Trump and Mike Collins will never understand — that our national greatness flows not through our blood or our genes but through our ideas, our aspirations, and our care for one another.
Mike Collins, who put people with Klan ties in campaign leadership roles, who personally himself has promoted neo-Nazi propaganda, who praised a mob that was harassing a Black woman on a college campus with monkey sounds.
And I don't know if you saw the debates last week. _Mike, if you want to go again, I'm ready. I'm ready, Mike._
See, at last week's debate, he couldn't even bring himself to say he'd stop the production of neo-Nazi propaganda from his own house. Did you see that? I told Mike we could shake on it. All he had to do was stop neo-Nazi propaganda from his house for three weeks. He refused.

A sitting Congressman currently running for the Senate hosts a neo-Nazi at his house, and that neo-Nazi produces neo-Nazi propaganda from his house, and the Congressman won't, or maybe can't, get the neo-Nazi in his house to stop producing neo-Nazi content from his house while he's running for the United States Senate.
A crumbling little bigot. See, Georgia, a man who won't take responsibility for what happens under his own roof can't be trusted with our national affairs. That's not the only question Mike won't answer. Mike's like a scandal piñata. Every time you shake him more misdeeds fall out.
He's not just surrounded by white nationalists, he's also under federal investigation for the illegal misuse of tax dollars. And rather than come clean, the Office of Congressional Conduct reports that Mike "refused to cooperate." They recommended he be subpoenaed and forced to testify. And Mike won't even say if he'll testify. Listen, Georgia, Mike Collins needs to testify.

They'd see that slavery had been abolished. They'd see that Americans without land and then women and then the descendants of slaves had secured voting rights.
They'd see that our science and technology propelled human knowledge to unimaginable heights and that those 13 colonies grew into a superpower that defeated the Nazis and communism. They'd see a pluralist democracy, people descended from every point on Earth of all colors stitched together out of many nations into one.

They'd see that we did those great things but then succumbed to a small and self-serving politics, unmoored from fixed moral principles, incapable of inspiration or great national achievement, with no real horizon beyond the next election.
And they'd see that what's required of us now is far, far greater than what that small, self-serving politics can muster.
I've got two little girls at home. Eva's four, and Lila's one. And I'm so grateful to this country for the security and opportunity it affords them. But this isn't the world I want to leave them. Soon enough, they'll learn there's now plastic in human blood and breast milk, that toxic forever chemicals are in half the country's drinking water.
Eva loves animal documentaries and she'll learn that the butterflies are dying off. She'll learn about the nuclear weapons that still threaten annihilation. She'll ask me why I allowed these things to happen. And when you step back and consider it, the situation's absurd.

An ancient establishment barely capable of email sleepwalks into a technological revolution while the president dismantles precautions and calls us fools for worrying.
And what fills us with dread is the crushing weakness of our politics against the massive stakes of our times. You see this scenario, and you look at the state of our politics, and it shakes your faith in the future. I get it.
But Georgia, we can and will reclaim control over our own destiny. We can and will meet our obligations to our children. And that begins with victory this fall, because Georgia, I refuse to leave my girls a world as dark and dangerous and cruel as this one threatens to become.
And I can't stop thinking about it. I refuse to accept that Eva and Lila will grow up with artificial friends and teachers in a society where the sick die, not because there's no cure, but because they have no money.
Where we have enough nuclear weapons to destroy the world a thousandfold, but we still refuse to guarantee health care for every citizen. On a poisoned planet rearming for world war where human life is cheap and might makes right.
See, when Eva's old enough to ask me why I let this happen, I'm determined to answer truthfully that I didn't. I'll tell her how the same year she turned five, Georgia overcame every doubt and dirty trick, not just to win, but to set a new course for our state and our country and the world. I'll tell her our generation didn't shrink from its obligations to hers.
That instead we came together, clear-eyed about the stakes and what was required of us. That we protected the sanctity of the vote and defeated those who attacked it. That we elected those who understood the moment and had the will to meet it.
That we restored American leadership toward peace and human rights. That we guaranteed health care for every citizen, and that we mastered technology instead of letting it master us. That we ensured each generation achieves health and prosperity greater than the last. And that we lived up to the promise of equal justice for all.
**We can and will do these things, and it starts with victory in 17 days, Georgia.** Because, Georgia, our power's right there, just waiting for us to pick it up. Freedoms guaranteed at our founding, made real through struggle and sacrifice in places like Seneca Falls and Selma and Stonewall.
Over centuries, despite our sins and through courageous struggle, the flame of American freedom has grown brighter and bolder and given hope to the whole world. But we see that in the winds that blow today, that light is flickering.
The Fulton County ballot raid, executive orders attacking voting, the MAGA loyalists on our state Election Board. The election deniers and insurrectionists and their accomplices have made their plans very clear.
But when voting rights and civil rights that heroes marched and died to secure are under attack, we defend those rights by using them. And that's why Georgia Democrats are answering with a mobilization so massive and a defense of voting rights so fierce that no plot against the franchise will foil the will of the people.
Because how foolish of them to come to the cradle of the Civil Rights Movement to spread those lies and seize those ballots. They launched an attack on voting rights at the political and spiritual center of the very Black history they seek to erase.

See, Georgia, a wave is building — the kind of wave that comes once a generation, when the people have been pushed too far, and they decide all together, all at once to say enough is enough.

Trump with such clarity and power that no president will dare such abuses again for centuries. At a rally earlier this week in Ohio, the president egged on supporters who assaulted a woman demanding the release of the Epstein files. Did you see that? Hey everyone, I posted the other day about political text messages and the repeated harassment we get on our phones.
Some people in the comments said, **" Didn't you see the STOP to opt out portion?"**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8Oc7kgaiDjZ9qDV3gvgZB04MH9f_8V5-VRkn4who_9o?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221230431)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..8Oc7kgaiDjZ9qDV3gvgZB04MH9f_8V5-VRkn4who_9o?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=221230431)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/80a529c0-ea7c-4579-acb9-b251fa0ee306?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yes. I saw it. That does not mean your number disappears from every other campaign, contractor, and fundraising database that already has it.
Other people objected because I used a message asking for money for Sherrod Brown, as though a Democrat we like **cOuLd NoT pOsSiBlY** be associated with the same fundraising tactics everybody complains about.
Come on.
I ran for Congress twice. I participated in this system. I paid for services, entered into fundraising arrangements, and hired people to send messages on my behalf.
So I want to explain how this works, where your information can come from, and why opting out of one message does not necessarily mean the messages stop.
* * *
## First, You Turn Your Relationships Into a List
One of the first things people tell you when you run for office is to "Rolodex yourself."
Write down everybody you know. Friends, family, former coworkers, business contacts. Pull all contacts from social media and emails. Then get on the phone or the keypad and ask them for money and support.
That becomes your first fundraising list.
It is valuable because these are people who know you, trust you, or might be willing to help you. Before you have a national audience or a professional fundraising operation, those relationships are what you have.
My next step was working with consultants and fundraising services. That involved uploading contact information so they could help manage the operation.
Maybe I got bamboozled. At the time, I was thinking about getting help running a campaign. I was not thinking through every possible future use of the information I was handing over.
I do not have proof that somebody took my friends' numbers and sold them to another campaign.
But the experience made me ask a question I should have asked much earlier: What rights am I giving somebody else over this information?
Because to you, that is your phone number. Inside a fundraising operation, it's MONEY BABY!!!!
* * *
## Eventually, Your List Dries Up
You call the people you know. You email them. You ask again.
Eventually, you reach the limits of what that list can produce. So where do you find more people?
Other campaigns have lists. Fundraising companies have lists. Political organizations have lists.

body:
Too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott’s leadership.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Texas is a big state. **In fact, Texas has more counties than any other state in the country.**
With **254 counties** , from the Panhandle to the Rio Grande Valley, East Texas to the Hill Country, every community has its own story, its own challenges, and its own vision for the future.
But too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott’s leadership.
[**We’ve got more to say, but first: can you pitch in $2.54, a penny for each of the 254 counties Abbott has failed?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1712?c0=em_ms_gh_20261019_3_2.54.8c8W94&refcode=em20261019-2482&t=1&akid=2482%2E299639%2ETuXiIq)
[Donate $2.54 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1712?c0=em_ms_gh_20261019_3_2.54.8c8W94&refcode=em20261019-2482&t=2&akid=2482%2E299639%2ETuXiIq)
Gina has traveled thousands of miles across Texas, sitting down with voters, listening to their concerns, and hearing what they need from their next governor.
She’s met teachers worried about the future of public education. Families struggling with rising costs. Small business owners trying to keep their doors open. Rural communities fighting to have a say in decisions that affect their land, their resources, and their way of life.
Everywhere she goes, Gina hears the same message: **Texans are ready for leadership that actually shows up.** And last week, Greg Abbott couldn’t even show up to debate her.
Abbott has spent years prioritizing billionaire donors, corporate interests, and political insiders. This campaign is about something different: a Texas where every community has a voice and every family has a chance to thrive.

clean_body: Too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott’s leadership. Peter, Texas is a big state. In fact, Texas has more counties than any other state in the country. With 254 counties , from the Panhandle to the Rio Grande Valley, East Texas to the Hill Country, every community has its own story, its own challenges, and its own vision for the future. But too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott’s leadership. Gina has traveled thousands of miles across Texas, sitting down with voters, listening to their concerns, and hearing what they need from their next governor. She’s met teachers worried about the future of public education. Families struggling with rising costs. Small business owners trying to keep their doors open. Rural communities fighting to have a say in decisions that affect their land, their resources, and their way of life. Everywhere she goes, Gina hears the same message: Texans are ready for leadership that actually shows up. And last week, Greg Abbott couldn’t even show up to debate her. Abbott has spent years prioritizing billionaire donors, corporate interests, and political insiders. This campaign is about something different: a Texas where every community has a voice and every family has a chance to thrive.
